# 贯穿角色与物件表演

角色不是随句子换装的贴图。输入角色设定、跨镜状态、动作意图、接触物和时间表，输出有注意、因果与重量的表演。已有纸偶方法保留于 [paper-performance](paper-performance.md)，像素/手绘实现保留于 [craft](../implementations/craft/README.md)，本次基础骨架见 [character](../implementations/character/README.md)。

## 角色设计表与跨画风身份

| 必填项 | 可执行记录 |
|---|---|
| 剪影/比例 | 头身比、主轮廓、辨识附件；说明正侧背面的对应 |
| 色与表情 | 1–2个识别色；中性/注意/疑惑/确认等表情的眼眉口参数 |
| 骨架 | 根节点、躯干、头、上臂/前臂、腿的父子关系；关节pivot与部件坐标 |
| 接触点 | 脚底、手握点、坐面、视线目标；世界坐标和物件局部坐标分开 |
| 替换件 | 口型、眼睑、手势、侧面头等稳定id；谁遮挡谁 |
| 跨镜状态 | 面向、视线、手中物、重心、动量及离场方向 |

同一小人物换蓝图/像素/编辑风时，保留剪影特征、比例、识别色关系、道具和行为性格。蓝图可改为线条结构，像素可减细节但保持头身比和动作关键姿势，编辑风可平面化；不要每章重新随机生一个角色。采用特定真人/已有角色素材时，来源与使用范围按项目记录，不把概念小人示例当已交付角色资产。

## 一次行动的六段

注意目标→反应→预备→动作→结果→余韵。不是每段都要等长或显式停顿：轻动作可压缩，关键转折需要让观众看到决定。

示例：小人发现挡路的块，眼睛在0.0 s转向，头0.08 s跟，身体0.18 s转；0.3–0.55 s后坐预备；0.55–0.95 s推块；0.95 s块开始移动；人物前倾余量在1.1–1.35 s收回。声音落在接触/滑动事件，不落在手臂开始抬起时。

| 技法 | 参数与做法 | 何时不用/返修 |
|---|---|---|
| 视线引导 | 眼先头后，延迟0.05–0.15 s起步；目标需换到角色局部坐标 | 所有部件同拍会机械；眼球越框→椭圆限制 |
| 重心/接触 | 支撑足世界坐标锁定，髋在支撑区；接触前速度大、接触后压缩/稳定 | 脚滑→先修地面锁，再修腿；不能靠抖镜遮滑步 |
| 持物 | 手握点与物件把手同坐标约束；另一手可有轻微延迟 | 物件与手独立插值会穿帮；不能每帧重新猜抓点 |
| 跟随重叠 | 躯干主动作，头发/衣角/尾巴延迟0.04–0.16 s，幅度递减 | 安静段不要每件都摆；尾摆穿体→限角/分层 |
| 眨眼/表情 | `blinkAt` 种子固定，间隔约4 s带变化，闭合约0.14 s | 与信息重音错开；每秒同拍眨眼→增间隔与种子分散 |
| 简化口型 | 实际音素或人工标注闭口/开口/圆唇事件；说完归中性 | 只有音量包络就称“振幅口型”，不冒称唇同步；保留所选音色身份 |
| 挤压拉伸 | 接触瞬间纵向压5–12%，横向补偿保持体积感；0.08–0.18 s恢复 | 写实人物/精密物体慎用；过度导致身份变形→收幅 |
| 群演 | 主角先行动，配角降低幅度/对比，必要时错开0.1–0.3 s | 所有人抢反应→删掉无叙事作用的动作 |

## 行走、跑、跳

行走四关键姿势：接触→下压承重→经过支撑脚→上升抬脚。以周期0.8 s、速度110 px/s、抬脚36 px为示例，步幅=速度×周期；不分别随意调步幅和速度。`walkPose` 两脚相位相差半周期，stance=.6，支撑时脚点固定；`WalkCycle` 是两节腿闭式IK的简化SVG示范，参数超出腿长可达域会明确报错。

跑步有腾空段、接触更短、躯干前倾；不能只把行走加速。用 `poseTimeline` 显式写接触、压缩、腾空、落地姿势，搭配根节点位移。跳跃先下蹲0.15–0.3 s，再按抛物线/设计曲线飞行，落地时脚先接触、身体压缩、最后恢复。`throwSnap` 可辅助物件弧线，但不是完整跑跳控制器。

逐格风格按绘制拍数采样：24 fps的on-twos=12 drawings/s；30fps保持每两帧则15 drawings/s，不能机械把所有工程设12。根运动与部件姿势是否都步进应统一设计。像素保持整数像素/整数放大、nearest；手绘可重复少量受控轮廓，不随机破坏接触点。真实运动模糊适合连续运动；像素/定格多用清晰姿势或专门smear帧，不能一律开CSS blur。

## 物理表演配方

| 手法 | 公式/参数 | 边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 小角度钟摆 | `pendulum(t,{length:1,gravity:9.81,amplitude:.25,damping:.3})` 返回rad | length米、gravity m/s²；仅小角度近似，阻尼为包络，不是完整刚体 |
| 橡皮筋回弹 | 先确定固定端和拉伸向量，松手后按 `springAt` 回到目标 | stiffness/damping按同一模型，别累积每帧求解；文字读窗需先停稳 |
| 抛掷吸附 | `throwSnap` from/to px、flight .7 s、height100 px；抵达后可选衰减余振 | 只保证位置连续，接触速度可故意突变；需要平滑速度则另设计缓冲段 |
| 弹跳 | 碰撞时刻显式列出，飞行段闭式抛物线，后跳高度递减 | 不是无约束穿地spring；声音只在真正接触时触发 |
| 软体接触 | 接触前不形变；接触后局部压缩+相邻面积补偿，再恢复 | 简化视觉形变需标明，不称真实材料模拟 |

跨镜接力保留上一镜最终持物/朝向；页翻或换画风也不重置人物动机。审片定位：滑步→脚锁/根速度；漂浮→接触影/重心；木偶感→注意与反应先后；表情乱跳→统一事件；纹理抖动→固定seed和绘制拍。当前源码未编译、未运行、未出角色成片。

# 图表、地图与产品操作

输入是真实数据/来源、要证明的关系、产品真实或示意状态、事件表和可读尺寸。输出应让观众看懂一次比较或一次操作的因果。代码见 [data-ui](../implementations/data-ui/README.md)。装饰动效不能改变事实或伪造产品能力。

## 数据先于动画

| 要回答的问题 | 图形与步骤 | 参数/读窗起点 | 避免与修法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 谁更大/差多少 | 横条按固定域从旧值到新值，最后标差值 | 0.6–1.2 s 变化、至少一次完整比较的停留；domain 含0 | 条形截断基线夸大差异→回零基线或明确换适合的图形 |
| 随时间怎样变 | 折线沿真实时间坐标，弧长揭示；缺失数据留断口 | 1–2 s 揭示，非均匀时间不等距；LineReveal | 把缺测连线/填0→保留 null；平滑插值不能越过真实极值 |
| 构成如何 | 少数分类可堆积条/环；总量和分母标清 | 角度=值/总值×2π，总值0时不画伪比例 | 类太多→改条形；不能让大扇区延迟导致暂时错误总量 |
| 排名变化 | 稳定 id 对应条，数值和排名位置共同变化 | 两个真实快照间 0.8–1.5 s；相同值按稳定id | 重建列表导致跳身份→固定id；过程排名仅插值示意，非新测量 |
| 分布/关联 | 有真实样本才用直方/散点 | 固定分箱/坐标域，点按id；标样本量 | 用漂亮随机点充数据→删掉或显式模拟 |
| 流程/系统 | 先节点职责再连接，沿因果方向送信号 | 节点进入 0.2 s、边0.4 s、结果稳定 | 全部箭头同时发光→按事件只亮当前因果链 |

动画期间数字、条长、颜色阈值共用 `dataValue(datum,p)`；`CountUp` 只格式化给定值，不自造第二条进度。单位/小数精度由数据决定，图例不能迟到。金额、百分比、百分点不能混用。显示临时插值应标明“变化示意”，最终值与来源一致。图形位置可以缓动，数值不可无理由弹簧过冲到未发生的峰值。

```tsx
const p=smooth(unit(t,1,2));
<AnimatedBars data={rows} progress={p} domain={[0,100]} rank={false}
  width={1200} height={500} family="ProjectSans" sourceLabel="示例数据（非实测）" suffix="%"/>
```

`AnimatedBars` 简化避让会暂隐碰撞标签，不能代替审读；到站后必须全量可读。长标签预先换行/增加左边距或改版。图表的轴、单位、来源是必要信息，不能作为微小装饰脚注。负值过零时以零线为轴向另一侧生长。

## 地图与路线

先选真实地理还是关系示意。等距经纬投影保留经纬网但高纬形变明显；墨卡托局部角度较直观但面积误导，纬度截到±85.0511°。面积比较不能使用墨卡托图大小作依据。

1. 核坐标顺序为 `[纬度,经度]`、单位度，来源、日期与坐标系。外部地图服务的 token、许可与网络依赖另列，当前包不提供底图。
2. 两地点间以球面大圆采样；跨180°时在左右画边分段，不能横穿整幅地图。近对跖点需要显式中继点，不自动选含义不明路线。
3. 0.2–0.4 s 建立地点，0.8–1.8 s 沿弧长揭示路线，末端停稳后显示标签。长短路线按信息量调速，不所有路线等时同发。
4. 标签优先起终点/当前节点。备选上下左右位置与锚线，碰撞时移标签、错峰或局部放大，不能删重要名称。主体路线和标签避开字幕区。
5. 相机在路线前留一点空间引导，抵达前减速；边界、领土、交通时长不能由示意曲线推断。

`GeoRoute` 只画简化投影路线，默认“路线示意”，无行政边界、地形或权威底图。传 progress=0…1，width/height px；需要多段途经点时分段安排事件，实际行程不是自动最短大圆。

## UI 操作的五个状态

先完整展示前态→用户输入→触发→真实处理→结果证据。每次演示都写发生在 `pointer.down` 还是 `pointer.up`，结果在哪个事件后可见。处理延迟、进度条、错误状态依据产品事实；模拟内容需标“交互示意”。

| 动作 | 可执行时序与参数 | 实现/常见失败 |
|---|---|---|
| 光标移动 | 两绝对坐标间 0.25–0.65 s；贝塞尔控制点避免机械折线，到目标略停 | `Cursor` hotspot 左上尖端(0,0)；按钮变换后须重新投影位置 |
| 点击 | hover 0.12 s→down 0.08–0.14 s→up→响应 | presses 的 down/up 秒；ripple 可关。不是每个点击都需要音效/圆环 |
| 拖拽 | down 时锁局部抓点→物件跟随光标→up 后落位或回弹 | `cursorPoint(t,keys)` 共用给物件；拖动中对象跳中心→减去抓点偏移 |
| 输入 | 焦点先落在输入框，显式输入事件，完整后触发 | `typingTimes` seed固定、标点停顿；`TypeIn`。展示速度不等于人的真实打字记录 |
| 选区/代码 | 固定等宽字体与行高→选区增长→编辑/diff→保留上下文 | 区域按真实字形宽测量，不能默认中文字符半个格；删除/新增有图例 |
| 聚焦结果 | 结果先出现，再把镜头移向证据；稳定后读标签 | `cameraCenterForAnchor`，屏幕字幕保持；别放大整个设备到看不清真实结果 |
| 多设备/屏幕流 | 同一状态在各设备建立对应，逐个成为焦点 | `DeviceFrame` 只画框，内容自供；模拟界面不能宣称真实截图 |

代码演示可以按步骤瞬时替换/高亮，不必从空白逐字打完。diff 用同一行号/稳定id，删除色和新增色有文字说明；高亮范围与叙述一致。光标形状只是提示工具，不能盖住按钮文字。长等待压缩时显式说明时间缩略。

未来媒体审读重点：数值与图形是否同源、来源/单位、地图跨边、按钮热点、触发先后、最终结果读窗。当前版本未运行这些组件。

# 导演判断、分镜深度与细节返修

一镜首先要说明“观众看完后，理解发生了什么变化”。然后为变化找承载对象、动作和关系，最后才选效果。全文的事实、因果和已确认决定见 [meaning](../modules/meaning.md)、[decisions](../modules/decisions.md)。逐镜用 [shot-sheet](../templates/shot-sheet.md)；不要把效果目录本身当分镜。

## 可执行深度

每镜交代主体/初末状态、背景/中景/主体/文字/前景各层作用、动作曲线、镜头坐标、进出场、文字读窗、声音事件、与下一镜的接力。无需每层都动，空层写“无”比为了填表堆装饰更好。

| 模糊写法 | 可执行写法（数值为设计示例） |
|---|---|
| 有气势地出现 | 先0.2 s收掉副元素，主词从1.5倍缩到1，尾振上限4%；背景降低亮度；落稳后保留2 s读窗 |
| 小人很努力 | 眼先看重块、后坐预备、双手接触；块未动时身体压低，0.8 s后块动、身体前倾收回 |
| 背景活一点 | 深蓝底上220个低亮度点按固定seed漂移；正文框内亮度权重降到.05；读结论时固定相位 |
| 镜头推进 | 中心从(960,540)到证据锚点，zoom1→1.18，1.2 s log-zoom；字幕留屏幕层 |
| 顺滑转场 | A中的圆盘保留屏幕锚点，B的图表从同位置展开；重叠.45 s，旧场被全遮后卸载 |
| 把数字展示出来 | 固定0–100域，条长和数字共用同一p；0.8 s到最终值，单位/来源始终在场 |
| 文字依次出现 | 按两个显式意群遮罩上移，各.3 s，间隔.1 s；最后落字后开始静读计时 |
| 画面丰富一些 | 主图承担证据，侧边一条路径解释关系，背景只保留材质；删除不改变理解的第三焦点 |
| 音乐在这里爆 | 计划E_RELEASE处要求增加密度，作者选音后标真实起音；允许镜头切点±.06 s，口播词锚固定 |
| 页面像真的一样 | 记录前态、输入、down/up、处理和结果事件；模拟界面标示意；不写未经证实的真实延迟 |
| 结尾舒服一点 | 回到开头同一对象，动作完全落稳，文案读完；保留实际音轨尾音，duration覆盖尾部 |
| 加一点手绘感 | 使用既定字体与稳定纸纹，轮廓3个受控姿态以12 drawings/s切换，脚底接触点不抖 |

## 反逐句贴卡

症状：每句都标题+图标+淡入，平均镜长，相同缩放入场，没有对象状态连续性，观众只能读字幕得知内容。

修法顺序：先提取段落关系，再找可持续的物件/角色/空间。因果用前动作改变后状态，对比用同尺度，递进让已有结构增加功能，转折改变方向或规则。上一镜的结果成为下一镜的输入；无法物理连接时用明确硬切，不虚构连续性。教学/产品里的稳定布局有价值，不能为“去PPT”强迫每镜换风格或添加夸张动作。

## 气势、节奏与构图

全片画一条主能量曲线，再分开记录运动幅度、视觉密度、声音密度和语义难度。四者同时最高通常难读。高潮前可以减少元素/停顿，让变化有比较；高潮之后留结果而非立即塞下一句。重复建立规则，变化打破规则；每次重复应有新的信息，不只是换颜色。

一镜一个主要注意目标，次级目标支持主目标。用大小、对比、位置、朝向和动作先后引导；不是所有手段都同时最大。负空间给关系与阅读留位置，网格负责对齐但可在转折处有理由突破。密度按屏幕实读评估，不把“某类画面占35%”当普遍标准。复杂信息段相机可以完全不动。

## Detail pass：加之前先说作用

| 层 | 可加的细节 | 何时减/不加 | 追到哪类参数 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 二次动作/跟随 | 头发、衣角、尾部比主动作晚一点 | 图表/小字号说明不需要弹尾 | delay、damping、幅度、接触约束 |
| 微反馈 | 按钮压下、落地压缩、线条接管 | 每字震动/每hover发声会抢信息 | event id、持续时间、scale上限 |
| 材质 | 纸纹、金属扫光、像素边缘 | 低对比细节压缩后闪烁就删 | 纹理频率、alpha、绘制拍数 |
| 光影 | 接触影随高度、共同灯光方向 | 无接触却有固定深影不成立 | 光方向、shadow距离/软度、depth |
| 接缝 | 承载物延续、方向速度匹配、晚卸载 | 无动机的场场长叠化要缩短 | start/end、z-order、根底色 |
| 文字末端 | 描边收口、最后字稳住、断行平衡 | 空间不足先重排，别强加装饰 | mask边距、最大变换框、lastLetterAt |
| 明暗 | 共用dark(t)驱动场景所有支路 | 背景变暗灯却不变会跳 | 材质/雾/环境/后期的同一变量 |
| 声音 | 材质匹配、峰值同步、尾音、适当轮换 | 无叙事作用的whoosh/低频冲击 | peakOffset、gain、duck、尾长 |

CSS 3D在90°附近面消失、Three测量尺寸和CSS scale冲突、透明物排序、反面剔除、退化法线都可能造成黑/白闪。修几何和挂载时序，不能用闪白转场遮盖错误。光照变化要读所有条件分支，共享物件保留到交接后再卸。

## 分层审片与返修

只在本次授权包含观看/播放/渲染时执行；当前版本没有执行媒体审片。

1. 结构：无声音能否看懂主要关系？否定/因果是否反了？信息是否真实？先修意思。
2. 节奏：听句读、看最后落字、停留与高潮。读不完先减信息/延长，不机械加速旁白。
3. 动作：接触、速度、连续性、视线和镜头锚点；逐接缝看前后与运动中间。
4. 细节：字体、裁切、粒子字、透视、透明度、材质；按目标观看尺寸与原尺寸各查必要部分。
5. 声音：分轨和合听，核接触峰值、口播让位、结尾及编码后同步；机器峰值不能代替听觉。

| 严重度 | 例子 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| P0 阻断 | 错误事实/句意反转、素材缺失、文件损坏 | 停止称可交付，先修根因 |
| P1 主要理解失败 | 核心字不可读、因果断裂、接触滑步、整体音画迟 | 定位事件与参数，回看同类受影响镜头 |
| P2 体验问题 | 次要动效机械、局部拥挤、轻微接缝差 | 在不伤主表达前提下修 |
| P3 可选打磨 | 不影响理解的材质/细微个性 | 与时间预算权衡，不能伪装成阻断 |

每条返修写镜头/时间范围、现象、预期、证据、根因假设、具体代码/参数、修改、实际复核范围。审美异议保留作者判断，不用自动分数替代。机器检查、实际观看、作者采用各自记录，原版的PASS不自动继承。

## 跨 Agent 的一致与自由

必须一致：全文意义、真实数据/素材、阶段授权、作者决定、字体/角色身份、时间基准、事件id、图层坐标、源码与许可、未完成状态。可以自由：不冲突的构图、路径、动效组合、细节和风格内变体。交接写清哪些已定、哪些是候选、哪些需要作者判断；不要把上一Agent的设计偏好升级成用户命令。

# 群体成形、马赛克翻面与编队

保留完整技术配方与返修案例。以下具体配色、时长、左右方位和声效密度都是案例选择；按本片含义调整。制作前先读 [阶段与工作流](../modules/workflow.md)。代码片段是实现说明，不是已经在本机运行的完整引擎。

输入：同一批元素的home/formation offset、目标轮廓、种子、全局时间、接触/翻面事件。输出：可任意seek的位置、旋转、材质及共享事件表。需要GPU的代码保留为实现配方；纯逻辑编队与接触响应已在 [motion-core](../implementations/motion-core.mjs) 实现。

# Tiles and flocks: figures made of many small elements

For films where the picture is built from thousands of elements that each have a home, such as mosaic
tiles, paper scraps, leaves, pixels, birds, letters or dominoes, and where figures are made by those
elements moving together: "a fish swims by its tiles swimming". Worked example at the end
(an 80 s glass and gold-leaf mosaic in WebGL2, no libraries and no asset files).

## Contents
1. The rule: flocks without simulation
2. Data per element
3. Motions: lift, fly, land, flip, wave, spiral, peel and swarm
4. Keeping figures legible
5. Rendering in WebGL2 (instancing) and materials (gold leaf, glass smalti, plaster)
6. Sound from the same data
7. Loops, square format, no-asset constraint
8. Worked example: the mosaic wall that was never glued

## 1. The rule: flocks without simulation

A boids simulation depends on history, which breaks `seek(t)`. Replace every flocking rule
with a closed-form expression of `t`:

| Flocking behaviour | Closed form |
|---|---|
| cohesion / keeping the figure's shape | each element has a fixed **formation offset** `o_i` in the figure's local frame |
| alignment / following the leader | one shared **path** `P(τ)` and heading `θ(τ)` per figure (keyed spline); element `i` samples it at `τ = t − d_i` |
| separation / individuality | small **flutter**: sum of 2–3 sines with per-element seeded frequency and phase, faded by an envelope |
| a body that swims or flaps | a travelling wave on the offsets: `o_i.y += A · sin(k·o_i.x − ω t) · taper(o_i.x)` |

```js
// element i of figure g at time t (2D wall coordinates + z toward the camera)
function flight(i, t) {
  const e = EL[i], g = FIG[e.fig], tau = t - e.delay;                // tail lags the head
  const p = g.path(tau), th = g.heading(tau), s = g.scale(tau);
  const ox = e.o[0], oy = e.o[1] + g.wave * Math.sin(g.k * e.o[0] - g.w * t) * taper(e.o[0]);
  const c = Math.cos(th), sn = Math.sin(th);
  const fl = g.flutter * (Math.sin(t * e.f1 + e.p1) + .6 * Math.sin(t * e.f2 + e.p2));
  return [p[0] + s * (c * ox - sn * oy), p[1] + s * (sn * ox + c * oy) + fl, g.z(tau)];
}
```
The formation offsets are the elements' **home positions relative to the figure's anchor on
the wall**. The figure that flies away is exactly the figure that was in the wall, so it
lands back into its own hole.

## 2. Data per element

Build once, seeded (never `Math.random()` at draw time):
- `home` (grid cell centre, with a little seeded jitter and rotation, because real mosaics are hand set and uneven)
- `faces`: day and night material ids and colours (and a star or moon flag for the night face)
- `fig` (which figure it belongs to, or none), `o` (offset in the figure frame), `delay`
- seeds: `f1, f2, p1, p2` (flutter), `tilt` (a small normal tilt, which is what makes gold mosaics glitter)
- event times derived from the timeline: `tLift`, `tLand`, `tFlip`, and so on. Store them, because the sound reads them too.

Assign figure membership by rasterising a figure silhouette (a polygon or SDF) over the grid:
cells inside belong to it. Give the figure a one-tile **outline ring** in a contrasting
material (see §4).

## 3. Motions

**Lift and land.** Blend home → flight with an eased weight `w(t)` per element, staggered by
distance from the figure's head. Lift out of the wall first (`z = sin(πw) · h` pushes
toward the camera, with slight scale-up and a shadow offset on the plaster). Then fly.
**Click back into place** with a closed-form damped spring after contact time `tc`:
```js
const settle = t => t < tc ? 0 : A * Math.exp(-7 * (t - tc)) * Math.sin(38 * (t - tc));   // overshoot + ring
```
The sine starts at zero displacement; the original cosine jumped by A at contact. If contact velocity also must be continuous, solve amplitude/phase from incoming position and velocity. Add a tiny rotation wobble with the same envelope. The contact times are the click cues.

**Flip (day ↔ night).** `angle_i = π · ease((t − tFlip_i)/dur)`, where
`tFlip_i = t0 + |home_i − origin| / speed + jitter`, so the flip runs across the wall as a wave.
Draw the day face while `angle < π/2`, the night face after, and light it by `|cos angle|`.
While a tile is edge-on the wall behind shows. **If many tiles are edge-on at once the frame
flashes the backing colour.** Darken the backing during the wave, keep `dur` short, or
widen the wave front.

**Ripple / light sweep.** A travelling wave lifts tiles slightly:
`z += a · sin(k·|home − src| − ω t) · env`, and tilts their normals, so the glints run across the wall.

**Spiral release.** In polar coordinates about the centre: `φ(t) = φ_i + Ω(r_i) · g(t)`,
`r(t) = r_i · (1 + e·g(t))`. Use **differential rotation** (inner faster, e.g. `Ω ∝ r^-0.6`),
because with uniform rotation the spiral arms don't show. Snap back **from the centre outward**:
`tReturn_i = t0 + r_i / speed`.

**Peel and swarm into a constellation.** Assign star tiles to target points with a
deterministic assignment (greedy nearest, or Hungarian in a build step) to reduce travel; nearest/Hungarian assignment alone does not guarantee paths cannot cross. Inspect path intersections and add staging or depth when needed.
Travel on a Bézier from home to target with a lift. Swarm flutter is large at mid-flight and
zero on arrival. Draw constellation lines only after the stars settle, and fade them in.

## 4. Keeping figures legible (lessons from review)

- **Contrast with the ground.** A gold fish on a gold wall read as a blob. Make figures a
  different material (copper and orange glass) with a one-tile outline in a contrasting colour (blue).
- **Formation beats flutter.** When the flock was loose and fluttered a lot, the figure dissolved.
  Hold offsets tighter and reduce flutter so each figure keeps its shape in flight. Put the life
  into the path and the body wave instead.
- **Light must not wash out the symbols.** A moving light's reflections were washing out the
  sun and moon, so make reflections tighter (higher exponent) and weaker.
- **Background texture stays quiet.** Plaster stripes with too much contrast competed with the tiles. Tone them down.
- Check a frame-by-frame strip of every flip and every landing (sample the authorized preview at its actual 1/fps spacing).

## 5. Rendering in WebGL2

JS computes per-element state each frame (a few thousand elements is trivial), and the GPU draws
instanced quads and does the materials.

```js
const gl = cv.getContext('webgl2', { antialias: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true });  // preserve: capture tools read the canvas
const vao = gl.createVertexArray(); gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
const inst = new Float32Array(N * 12), ib = gl.createBuffer();
gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, ib); gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, inst.byteLength, gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {                         // 3 × vec4 per instance: pos.xyz+size, rot axis.xy+angle+face, material ids/seeds
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(k); gl.vertexAttribPointer(k, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 48, k * 16); gl.vertexAttribDivisor(k, 1);
}
// seek(t): fill inst from the closed forms, gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, inst);
//          draw the plaster (full-screen pass), then the shadows (instanced, offset, dark, soft alpha),
//          then the tiles: gl.drawArraysInstanced(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4, N)
```
The vertex shader builds the quad corner from `gl_VertexID` (`vec2(gl_VertexID & 1, gl_VertexID >> 1) - .5`),
rotates it by the flip angle about the tile's axis (a real 3D rotation, so edge-on tiles get thin),
and applies a mild perspective from `z`. Enable the depth test, or sort flying tiles by `z`.

Materials (fragment shader), each tile with its own seeded values:
- **Gold leaf**: base `(1.0, .78, .34)`, a faint crackle (cell-noise lines), and a **per-tile
  normal tilt** of a few degrees. As the light moves, tiles light up individually, which is the
  shimmer of real gold mosaics. Specular `pow(max(dot(R, V), 0.), 60.)` plus a broad sheen.
- **Glass smalti**: saturated colour, darker core with a brighter rim (thickness), a few tiny
  bubbles (dots), a slightly irregular edge (noise on the quad's alpha), and a sharp small highlight.
- **Night face**: navy glass, silver tiles for stars (a brighter, cooler specular), a moon built from tiles.
- **Plaster / grout**: warm lime, low-contrast trowel texture, darker in the gaps. Tiles cast soft
  shadows on it when they lift.

## 6. Sound from the same data

All synthesized in Web Audio. For export, render offline with `OfflineAudioContext` into a WAV and
mux it only in an authorized production phase; see [音乐与事件声音](../modules/music.md).
- **Clicks at every landing**: one short filtered noise burst + a tiny high sine per contact time,
  pitch seeded per tile, panned by screen x. Merge contacts within ~15 ms into one louder click
  (gain ∝ √count), or a mass landing turns into mush.
- **Shimmer** under the light sweep (a few high partials with slow tremolo), and a **chord pad**
  that swells during the spiral and resolves at the snap back.
- The clicks read their times from the element table, so retiming the picture retimes the sound.

## 7. Loops, square format, no-asset constraint

- 1080×1080 for a square post. For a loop, make state at t=duration equal state at t=0; encode frames 0..N−1, and inspect the last-to-first step rather than duplicating an endpoint and
  end on a small gesture (one last tile flips) before the fade.
- "No image, font or audio files": everything procedural. Text, if any, is built from tiles or
  drawn paths; system fonts only if the brief allows.
- WebGL-only films still follow the contract: `seek(t)` draws synchronously and the canvas uses
  `preserveDrawingBuffer: true`, so the future authorized capture adapter can read it.

## 8. Worked example: the mosaic wall that was never glued

Brief: 80 s, square, one HTML file, WebGL2 + plain JavaScript, no libraries, no image/font/audio
files. A glass and gold-leaf wall mosaic whose tiles were never glued down, so they can lift,
flip, fly and click back into place. Figures are flocks of tiles.

| Time | What happens |
|---|---|
| 0–8 s | A light sweeps across the gold wall; ripples run through the tiles |
| 8–21 s | The fish's tiles lift off and swim as a flock, leap, dive into the sea, and land back in place |
| ~21–34 s | Two cranes and a dove fly out of the wall the same way |
| 34–40 s | A wave flips every tile to its night face: navy glass, silver stars, a moon |
| 40–58 s | The stars peel off and swarm into a constellation |
| 58 s | A second wave flips the wall back to day |
| 63–72 s | The whole wall lets go into a spiral, then snaps back from the centre outward |
| 75 s | One last tile flips; fade out and loop |

Sound: a chord pad that swells during the spiral, a shimmer, and a small click whenever a tile lands.

Changes after watching it frame by frame: the fish went from gold to copper and orange glass
with a blue outline (it was a blob on the gold wall). The flocks were held tighter with less
flutter. The light's reflections were made tighter and weaker (they washed out the sun and moon).
The plaster stripes were toned down. The spiral got differential rotation so its arms show.

Still rough: the sky looks pale for about a second during the day-to-night flip, while the
tiles are edge-on (the backing shows, see §3). The night sea is close to black and needs a little teal.

# 中文动态文字与气势词

文字先承担句意，再承担动作。输入完整句子、显式意群、强调依据、字体文件、画幅和事件表；输出每组的进入、读窗、退出以及与主体动作的关系。读取 [文字模块](../modules/typography.md) 后使用本配方；实现见 [type-cn](../implementations/type-cn/README.md)。

## 先找真正改变句意的词

| 语义角色 | 表达任务 | 可选手段 | 容易犯的错 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 否定、条件 | 保全逻辑范围，如“不是…才…” | 与被否定部分一起出现、保留静读、划线后替换 | 把“不”当小字，观众读成相反意思 |
| 转折、结论 | 让关系改变可见 | 前项让位、位置转换、物件由阻挡变承载 | 只给“但是”放大，后果不变 |
| 数字、量级 | 让人比较 | 同基线、等宽数字、图形同源插值 | 计数器与条形分别 spring，显示相互矛盾 |
| 对比双方 | 对等比较 | 保持字号/尺度，改变关系或分区 | 一方大一方小，先替观众下结论 |
| 动作动词 | 驱动物件变化 | 字成为支点、牵引线、切割边或路径 | 每个动词都砸屏 |
| 情绪、气势词 | 表达蓄势或释放 | 停顿、留白、增重、周边退让、低频声、一次冲击 | 用震屏替代情绪积累 |
| 专名 | 建立识别 | 稳定字体与位置，首次完整出现 | 解码特效结束前就切走 |

三级力度是设计标签，不是固定动画档位：一级用颜色或字重；二级可加空间变化或主体回应；三级只给本段真正的转折/高潮，可用停顿后爆发，也可突然安静。必须写“为何强调、观众应理解什么”。口播强调与文字不一致时先核句意，不能机械追波形峰值。

例如“不是准备充分，才开始”应先把“不是”与被否定的条件建立关联，再把“开始”落到实际动作上。否定词保留到逻辑被看清；不能先展示一个未经否定的完整结论再迟迟补“不”。

## 一次文字事件的完整生命周期

1. 准备：字体就绪、按意群断行、给变换/描边留边。0.1–0.3 s 的提前让位可有可无。
2. 进入：意群通常用 0.2–0.5 s；组间错开 0.06–0.15 s 是起点，长句不能简单乘到末尾。
3. 可读：从最后一个必要字落稳开始计算。读速、尺寸和行距使用文字模块的区间；复杂数字和陌生名词另留停顿。并行动画不得占用读窗焦点。
4. 退出：0.15–0.4 s，或有理由地硬切。不要淡到难辨认仍算“可读”；字幕与人物表情需要同时理解时减少文字量。

标题讲结构和重音，字幕保全话语。字幕通常两行以内、位置稳定；标题可进入世界空间，字幕默认屏幕空间。竖版重新分组、重排关系和安全区，不能仅把横版整体缩小。

## 手法谱系

| 手法与适用 | 操作与时序 | 参数起点、实现 | 坏例与修法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 语义块遮罩上移：解释/递进 | 每块独立 mask，整体行先排好；按句意进入→静读→整句退出 | `SemanticMaskReveal`，rise 0.2–0.6 个字高，duration 0.25–0.45 s | 长意群溢出：先拆语义块；不能用空格切中文 |
| 字重/字宽轴：呼吸、加强 | 原字稳定→真实轴变化→稳定或回原值 | `WeightAxisPulse`，wght 如 400→650→400；只在实际 fvar 范围内 | 假轴无效/字宽挤行：核字体轴，预留最大宽度；需要持续加重用明确状态而非 pulse |
| 轮廓到填色：结构显现 | 轮廓可读后加填充，短暂双层交接 | 复用 `OutlineFill`；描线 0.5–1.2 s，填色 0.2 s | 洞被填死：保留轮廓绕向/填充规则 |
| 书写：时间和手势 | 先有真实笔顺路径，按弧长揭示，再保留成字 | 复用 `HandReveal`；见 [线描](type-and-lines.md) | 字体轮廓扫描不是笔顺；缺笔顺时明确称轮廓揭示 |
| 粒子聚字/散字：集合成为意义 | 字体 ready 后取笔画点；稳定 id 对应目标，收敛后冻结；退出可散回下一对象 | [群体](formation-and-mosaic.md)、`ParticleAtmosphere(mode='gather')`；目标漂移小于采样间距一半 | 外发光糊字：先减 bloom/扰动，再调采样，不盲加粒子 |
| 挤出字：体量、标牌 | 先定正面阅读角，厚度缓入，稳定面留读窗 | `ExtrudeText` depth 4–12 px 起步；CSS 阴影模拟 | 边层盖住字洞：减深度/角度；真实遮挡光照用 3D 另实现 |
| 字形变形/形状互换：概念接力 | 两形同锚点、匹配轮廓顺序/洞，再插值；不匹配时光学交接 | `TextMorphSwap` 0.25–0.5 s 仅是交叉淡入+位移；真轮廓 morph 需另做拓扑 | 称淡入为真变形，或中间字乱团：标清机制，改遮挡交接 |
| 拆字参与表意：结构说明 | 使用经核对的偏旁/部件路径；先完整字→部件行动→复原 | 部件锚点 px、角度 rad；复用 `Rig2D`，路径自行提供 | 任意切矩形制造错误字源：不把视觉比喻当语言学事实 |
| 打字机/流式：真实输入 | 显式输入事件，标点停顿，完整文本后停留 | `TypeIn`、`typingTimes`；中文展示 6–12 字/s、代码可更快但不要求逐字读 | 解释字幕全程打字：改意群出现；真实输入记录优先 |
| 乱码解码：状态确认 | 候选字闪变→逐位收敛→完整读窗 | `ScrambleDecode`，settle 0.25 s、perCharacter 0.025 s，seed 固定 | 候选字缺字/残留乱码：先查候选集 cmap，重要信息少用 |
| 高亮/划线/删改：校正 | 先读旧状态→标记→新状态替换→读新状态 | `MarkerHighlight`、`StrikeReplace`；总 0.4–0.8 s，预留新旧最大宽度 | 暗示旧内容错误却无依据：只用于文案授权的修订/否定 |
| 逐意群交叉淡入 | 原意群离场与新意群接入共享槽位 | `TextMorphSwap` travel 0–12 px，0.25–0.45 s | 两句长时间叠字：缩短重叠，必要时硬切 |
| 卡拉 OK 字幕 | 整句先可见，实测词/意群时间改变颜色，保留已读色 | `KaraokeCaption`，显式 `words[]` 的 start/end 秒 | 用均分时间假装对齐：标 planned，待实际成音重新标注 |
| Slam 冲击 | 空间/声音蓄势→一次入场→短尾振→长读窗 | `SlamIn` startScale 1.3–1.7，overshootLimit 0–0.06，shakePixels 默认 0 | 每句砸字、低帧率闪烁：降级成增重/停顿；不动相机也能有力量 |

## 可复制的意群写法

```tsx
// useFonts 在上层已就绪；t 为本场秒数，所有 at 同一坐标系。
<SemanticMaskReveal t={t} family="ProjectSans" size={72} rise={.4}
  parts={[
    {id:'condition',text:'不是准备充分，',at:.2,duration:.35},
    {id:'action',text:'才开始。',at:.65,duration:.35},
  ]}/>
```

一个主字族建立标题/正文/数字层级。像素风可用匹配的像素字体，但角色名、强调等级、排版关系跨段保持；不因“更有设计感”突然换手写字。特殊字形、书法或装饰字体属于作者需要判断的风格选项，已有授权可沿用，不重复申请。变量字体轴不等于通用缩放，手绘抖线也不能破坏正常汉字。

交卡检查：是否有否定范围、强调理由、完整读窗、真实字体/轴、横竖版重排、明确 planned/measured。未来获准看媒体时重点看最长句、最晚落字、最小尺寸和最大变换帧。本版未运行或渲染。

# 背景、粒子与氛围

背景支持主叙事，也可以成为承载对象；“活”不意味着一直运动。先写它表示什么（空间、密度、方向、材质或情绪），再选运动。正文阅读、细数据比较、静默停顿时可以冻结。模块见 [fields](../modules/fields.md)，代码见 [backgrounds](../implementations/backgrounds/README.md)。

## 先定空间和预算

每场明确背景是世界空间还是屏幕空间，是否跟相机。最多先放一个主环境变化和一个低对比材质层；这是调参起点，非数量硬指标。以 1920×1080 为参考，主体对比显著高于环境；降低粒子亮度/覆盖率比单纯调小尺寸更有效。画幅变化重算数量密度，不固定复制某个分辨率的颗粒数。

输入包括 `t` 秒、显式宽高 px、seed、阅读区矩形、目标形状点和事件。输出是本帧完整重建的画面。禁止上一帧位置累加、Date.now、无种子 Math.random、依赖鼠标/真实时钟的状态。Canvas 同步绘制放 layout effect；图片/字体异步资源由上层等待完成。

## 配方与参数

| 环境/语义 | 起势→变化→停留→退出 | 参数起点 | 实现、代价与修法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 流场：方向、系统流动 | 低密度底纹→方向逐渐弯转→主信息期间慢/停→流向下一镜 | 100 条×35 步，步长 6 px，周期 12 s | `FlowField` 每帧从同一粒子种子重建，成本 O(线数×步数)；不是时域流体模拟。线太密先减数量 |
| 漂浮尘点：空气与层深 | 预置稳定分布→低振幅漂移→保持→淡出 | 100–300 点，半径 1–3 px，14 s 周期，位移 18–24 px | `ParticleAtmosphere` drift；不宣称布朗物理。阅读区压低，别每个字下都有亮点 |
| 轨道群：环绕、中心组织 | 分散→环形轨道→聚焦中心→沿切线离开 | 轨道半径按短边 0.2–0.6，周期 8–16 s | orbit 是 2D 椭圆；遮挡/透视需分前后层，不能冒称真实3D |
| 聚字/聚形：集合形成对象 | 稳定 id 初态→错峰收敛→目标静止→下一形态 | gatherDuration 0.8–1.8 s，错峰 0–0.25 s | gather 需每粒一个目标；字形点来自已加载字体/合法路径。见 [群体](formation-and-mosaic.md) |
| 点阵/网格：秩序、局部扰动 | 静态规则→事件源发波→衰减→恢复秩序 | spacing 32–56 px，波幅 3–8 px，传播约 500 px/s | `DotGrid` 以事件时差闭式计算；不是持续弹簧仿真。网格若摩尔纹增间距 |
| 噪声渐变/云状：气氛转移 | 基底先稳→色团缓移→阅读降低幅差→收束色 | cell 16–32 px，octaves 2–4，period 12–24 s | `NoiseGradient` 低分辨率 value noise/fBm 放大；不是照片级云/流体。细节闪动先降 octave |
| 光扫/光斑：材质或发现 | 光从画外进→越过被强调对象→完全离开 | LightSweep opacity 0.08–0.25，0.6–1.5 s，angle 度 | 扫光受 mask 限制才像材质；整屏反复闪亮会抢字。不是 bloom 后期 |
| 暗角：收视线 | 极弱入场或常驻→保持→随整体光线退出 | `Vignette` strength 0.15–0.4 | 暗角不修复错误构图；边缘文字变暗先移动/减强度 |
| 颗粒/印刷纹：触感 | 固定材质或按绘制拍更换→留低频稳定→退出 | `Grain` opacity 0.02–0.08、1800 点、12 drawings/s | 静态纸面用固定 t；录像噪声才换样。压缩后闪烁要降密度，不把脏当精致 |
| 照片背景活化 | 主体焦点先核→低速裁切→阅读暂停→匹配下一图 | zoom 1→1.04–1.08，4–8 s | [Ken Burns](photo-and-montage.md)；有主体/文字保护区，不能假造分层边缘 |
| 图像切层视差 | 真实前/中/后景遮罩→远层小移近层大移→停稳 | 深度比 0.15/0.5/1，位移 8–40 px | 使用 `ParallaxLayer`；遮挡空洞需补画且标来源，不能只平移整图冒充切层 |

更复杂的域扭曲、反应扩散、SDF、流体和体积光需要特定渲染器及实现。当前目录没有完整 WebGL 求解器，不把 Canvas 噪声当这些效果。若选用，先在任务卡列明纹理、颜色空间、深度/alpha、确定性和资源预算，待授权再接入。

## 阅读区遮让

```tsx
const zones=[{x:140,y:700,width:1500,height:210,padding:32,feather:100,floor:.05}];
<ParticleAtmosphere t={t} width={1920} height={1080} seed="S03-bg"
  count={220} zones={zones} mode="drift"/>
```

`readingAttenuation` 返回 0–1 权重，边界外平滑恢复；它只抑制亮度/alpha，并不禁止粒子穿过文字。需要彻底避让时对目标/路径做几何排除，或在文字下面加符合画风的稳定底层。世界背景的阅读区必须先换到同一屏幕坐标。运动文字的位置变化要同步更新区域，不能只提供第一帧包围盒。

## 时间、循环和接缝

循环使用 `phase = 2π*(t mod period)/period`，用 sin/cos 控制位置；起终帧不要重复输出同一个循环端点。只保证位置相等不够，还需速度/亮度一致。固定拍采样可有风格跳变，但必须是主动选择。退出时共享背景可持续跨镜存在；若换 seed，应在遮挡或交接中进行，不能裸跳。

环境与音乐共用事件 id，能量可缓慢调幅，不要逐拍全屏闪。慢读段降低运动、对比和高频细节；高潮可以集中一次密度改变。bad case：背景比结论更亮→降低环境对比；粒子像雪花覆盖人脸→保护脸部；不同 seek 得到不同画面→重建所有位置；场景卸载透明→根层提供不透明底色。

本版只提供源码与配方。真实性、性能、循环接缝和最终编码效果尚未通过实际渲染确认。

﻿# 音乐、音效、口播与实际时间

先理解全文和段落，再共同设计镜头、动作、快慢、插图、留白与声音需求；框架定好才写四案。只交卡/静帧阶段不生成音乐。四案在获准制作时用本机 ACE-Step 1.5 生成，由作者选择具体音轨，再按实际声音校准。不是四个seed，也不是四种克隆音色。保留作者已选口播音色和原始录音。

## 从内容推导音乐结构

逐段记录“观众理解变化→视觉密度→运动能量→声音空间”。音乐密度和音量不是同一件事：一个很轻但高频复杂的节奏也会遮住中文辅音。计划表可写建立、推进、蓄势、释放、停顿、收束，不能把每段平均分配。

| 声音层 | 职责 | 设计与互让 |
|---|---|---|
| 口播 | 传达句意、态度、自然气口 | 以实际重音/停顿定必要阅读窗；不为卡拍把句子机械加速 |
| 音乐 | 长线情绪、结构与速度感 | 中频/主旋律让位口播，段落密度可变化；有意安静是结构 |
| 音效 | 对象、材质、动作因果 | 从接触/触发事件产生；不是每次入场都配同一个whoosh |
| 环境 | 空间、距离、连续性 | 跨镜可作声音桥；没有空间意图时不用常驻底噪 |

## 四案差异矩阵

至少在编制、节奏结构、动机、能量曲线、口播关系、结尾方式中有三维实质差异。下列只是如何比较，不是每片固定选四种流派。

| 方案 | 编制/节奏 | 动机/曲线 | 人声关系/结尾 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A 克制推进 | 毛毡琴+少量低音，4拍稀疏脉冲 | 短双音，后半小幅增密 | 句间回应，开放余音 |
| B 机械展开 | 木质敲击+干合成器，不对称分组 | 切分动机，密集段集中爆发 | 口播段抽掉中频，短确定落点 |
| C 空间呼吸 | 弦乐泛音+空气织体，自由时间 | 长音变化，高潮前留空 | 无抢词旋律，渐渐消隐 |
| D 手工叙事 | 拨弦+刷奏，三拍摇摆 | 可辨短乐句，快慢段对比 | 低密度伴奏，回到开头动机收束 |

每案说明为什么服务这篇文案、损失什么、对应哪种画风。四案不是“更轻/更重”一个旋钮的四档。模板见 [music-plan](../templates/music-plan.md)，完整已有例子见 [照片音乐走读](../examples/04-photo-music.md)。

## caption公式和真实接口

caption依次写：器乐性质与情绪→核心编制/音色→节奏与动机→预期段落密度→口播空间→结尾→避免项。分秒标记只表达意图，不承诺精确控制。完整英文句子比无层级标签堆更容易复核意图。

实际核读的是本机 ACE-Step 安装目录下 `scripts` 里的 `acestep_gen.py`（属本机环境，不随包），未调用模型。字段语义如下：

| SPEC字段 | 脚本行为 | 不保证什么 |
|---|---|---|
| caption | 作为整体生成描述传入 | 不支持逐镜头事件列表；LM可能改写实际描述 |
| duration | 请求生成时长（秒） | 不是实际解码采样数证明 |
| bpm / keyscale / timesignature | 传速度、调式、拍号提示；默认拍号字符串"4" | 不保证实测速度不变或强拍在指定秒点 |
| seeds | 每个seed单独生成；输出seedN.wav | 换seed不是换风格；跨环境不保证逐样本一致 |
| thinking / lm | 是否加载LM和选择LM；失败可降级 | 不是精确编曲控制器；记录实际thinking_used |
| dit | 选择本机已有生成模型配置 | 不自动证明模型存在/可用 |
| steps / shift | 采样参数，默认8/3.0 | 不是越大越好；本次未探索质量 |
| offload | 是否卸载到CPU | 不等于内存一定足够 |

脚本固定 `lyrics='[Instrumental]'`、`instrumental=True`、`guidance_scale=1.0`、WAV输出。没有独立负向prompt、精确段落时间、分轨或人声克隆输入。`ACE_MAX_NEW` 只限新生成数量；缺输出应读日志，不能盲重跑。已有文件按seed复用，**修改caption后必须使用新输出目录**，避免把旧seed结果当新方案。generation.json 的 outputs.seconds 是生成耗时，不是音频时长；实际音频时长要从采样数/解码读取。

## 密集展示段四步法

1. 先定视觉节奏：分类建立→快闪群→重点停留→收束，区分只感知风格与真正读内容的段。
2. 写音乐结构需求：快闪处希望脉冲密、重点处希望减层/留空，不把每张图预先钉死到假拍点。
3. 写四个不同方案并在授权后生成；作者以相同画面/大致同响度比较整体气质、快段适配、人声空间和结尾。
4. 对选中实际音轨标乐句/强拍/起音，再把允许移动的切图事件吸附；读窗、事实顺序和口播气口优先，不逐字卡拍。

## 试听选择和实测事件

比较时统一播放范围、画面和监听条件，先响度匹配再评判；“更响”容易被误认为“更好”。记录方案id、文件hash、版本、作者选择与保留/修改理由。选择一份具体文件，不只写“选A”。改编或替换文件后必须重新确认相关时间点。

乐句是结构，强拍是节拍层级，onset是候选起音，它们不等同。先听出乐句与停顿，再用波形/频谱候选定位，最后逐个听辨；BPM候选至少对比半速/原速/倍速。变速/自由时间用实测beat列表。`beatGrid` 只给 planned 网格，不是自动测拍工具。音频分析脚本可作为以后获准时的辅助，当前未验证它们对本音轨的准确性。

事件格式统一为 `id,at,time_basis,source_hash,evidence,role`；重复词另有 `word,occurrence,source_span`。包内旧卡可能写 `at_seconds`/`t`，接入时显式映射到 `at`，不能默默猜字段。测量集与计划集分别保留，同一id可各有一个时间基准。实测音轨hash、裁切、速度、重采样或口播版本变动会使相关测量失效；只改整体增益通常不改时标，但仍记录派生文件关系。

`snapEvents` 只移动 `allow_snap:true` 的事件，容差秒值如0.04–0.08起步，另设min_at/max_at保护读窗；重复词/固定口播/接触事件默认不浮动。保持原planned_at、delta、beat_id和证据。多事件吸附后可能合并到同一拍，必须按叙事检查顺序与碰撞，不能把函数返回当导演验收。

## 音效设计与感知峰值

| 事件 | 材质/力度 | 时长起点 | 同步与密度 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 轻点击/开关 | 干、短、小 | 0.03–0.12 s | 与真实触发边一致，非所有hover都发声 |
| 纸页/翻面 | 摩擦+轻落点 | 0.15–0.5 s | 摩擦可提前，落点对齐接管；纸张与金属不能同音色 |
| 落地/碰撞 | 主体重量决定低频与余响 | 0.1–0.8 s | 文件感知峰值对齐接触，次碰撞减弱 |
| 滑动/聚合 | 连续纹理或气流 | 覆盖动作主段 | 速度可影响强度，停住后及时退出 |
| 输入/多粒子 | 稀疏选择或聚类声 | 按意群/事件群 | 不逐字滴答；2–4个样本固定种子轮换，避免机关枪 |

文件起点≠感知峰值。若峰值距文件起点0.08 s、接触在2.0 s，播放从1.92 s开始。负开始时间需设计预滚或换素材，不直接截掉攻击。`sfxStart` 会报告needsPreRoll；`sfxTrack` 拒绝负起点。记录peakOffset的测量来源，不凭统一常数套所有音效。

## 混音、ducking与结尾

音乐gain是线性倍率，duckFloor=.25约为该轨原增益的四分之一，不是LUFS目标。用口播区间提前约0.12 s平滑让位、结束后0.3 s恢复作为起点；相邻语句重叠duck取最大活动而非相乘，以免抽吸。连续人声可以整段退音乐，不每个字起伏。按实听处理遮蔽和齿音，保留自然声线与气口。

网络交付可把−14 LUFS、真峰值≤−1 dBTP作为项目讨论起点；以实际平台/客户要求为准，编码后重新测量，不把线性gain或单轨峰值当最终响度。当前没有测量任何新音频。

结尾先找乐句终止与自然尾音，再决定画面是否陪尾、余音延长还是有意硬停。短交叉淡化可修剪接，但相位/低频仍要听；避免采样阶跃爆音。总duration必须覆盖计划保留的尾音。编码引入的偏移要实测，禁止套用某个样片的43.7 ms。只改增益不必默认重做全部画面，改速度/裁切则所有相关事件重新对齐。

# 叙事结构与返修配方

这些是可选结构，不是所有片子都走“痛点→卖点→CTA”。输入先有全文语义模型，输出再选结构。

## A. 因果解释

保留同一状态变量：原状态→触发→传播→结果→条件/限制。先建立对象，再让变化发生，最后停住结果。信息量大时将原因和后果分镜，但用路径/颜色/物件接力。检查：去掉文字后因果方向是否仍对；补文字后否定词和条件是否被吞掉。失败常是A、B同时出现，改为共享触发E01和可见传播时延。

## B. 概念阶梯

来源Renoise style-pack-03：点→线→面→体→场。只有内容本身存在粒度/规模升级时才用。每章写一个人的价值和一个具体机制，不能变成五种效果展览。一个点可以成为字的节点、线的起点、面的角、体的顶点、群体成员；转换由物件身份相接。

实现：单个`draw(g,t,theme)`可进入全屏、网格、立方体面和魔方；体素576实例与粒子阶段共享转折事件。局限：用真实产品/知识关系替换Renoise样片品牌和标志。源码示例名“60s”不保证实际时间；必须计算最终时长。返修“像别家”：检查借来的字形/引语是否离开本项目叙事，不只换颜色。

## C. 接力长镜头

适合真实输入→处理→结果→持续运行链路。每行写“从哪个物体变来”：输入框→参数标签→进入窗口→结果卡→日历→通知→循环。8–12状态或30秒只是来源样例，现实流程没有就缩短。每次变化保留一个锚点，镜头给新状态阅读窗。字和音效从同一事件取时间。坏处是为了丝滑强连无关功能，修法允许章间硬切并保留共同识别物。

## D. 诗与证据双层

诗意层表达感受，证据层说明真实能力/数字。形式可以来自主题（十四行诗、四季、反复句），不强迫中文套英语韵律。HUD若存在须能读、出处可查；“68万根实例=68万行代码”的视觉表达需真实数量，不把粒子密度随便写成统计。原完整样片工程未公开，不宣称随包能复现。返修先分清是诗不成立、证据不成立还是视觉拥挤。

## E. 多风格目录与长篇章节

每章一个信息任务和对应风格，统一字体/人物/主物件。先理解全篇，再安排视觉变化，不按每10秒机械换画风。目录窗口会缩放3D画布时先验证测量；大量视频墙可用低清代理减解码，但代理只用于远景，不影响主画面。素材要覆盖收窗全部尾帧，避免先停后露空底。章间给安静过渡，不要求每章配一首新曲。

## F. 反转/猜测/两难/游戏化

先写观众的初始判断、支持该判断的证据、改变判断的新事实、改变后能解释什么。没有新事实就不是反转。游戏化需要明确规则、选择和后果；奖励条不能替代真实理解。人物行为由目标推动，不因模板要求插入冲突。效果可以丰富，但禁止编造“实测”“成功调用”“用户反馈”增强戏剧。

每个结构的评估都回到全文：是否保留条件、关系和结论；不能仅以“镜头丰富”“转场多”判为更好。

# 纸偶表演、定格印刷与双联灯箱

保留完整技术配方与返修案例。以下具体配色、时长、左右方位和声效密度都是案例选择；按本片含义调整。制作前先读 [阶段与工作流](../modules/workflow.md)。代码片段是实现说明，不是已经在本机运行的完整引擎。

输入：人物身份/关节锚点、动作意图、绘制fps、输出fps、纸层深度、光方向。输出：姿势状态表、贴图烘焙预算、闭式或固定步长回放方案。静止阅读无需添加boil。输出帧率能被绘制帧率整除时持帧最均匀；不整除也可有意使用，但要记录节奏。

## 1. Cut-paper stop-motion print

Printed paper cut-outs shot frame by frame:
- flat colour fields made rich by texture;
- wobbly hand-cut edges;
- soft contact shadows on the sheet behind;
- a stepped pose rate under a perfectly smooth camera.

The paper kit, in four parts:
- `cutPoly`: hand-cut polygons;
- `PAPER`, `paperize`: paper fibre;
- `sprite`, `bakeLayer`: baked sheets with a rim and a shadow;
- `layerT`: parallax depth.

### 1.1 Look and palette
- **Four values do the work:**
  - a mid-value ground;
  - one high-chroma accent for the things that matter;
  - a cream for small lights (windows, collars, highlights);
  - an ink for the smallest details (birds, wires, hair, notes).
- **Flat fields, rich texture.** The frame reads like a print: never smooth airbrushed gradients.
- **Mix every shade toward the ink or toward the paper colour, never toward black or white** (`tone(hex, k)`). That keeps shadows and
  highlights inside the print's palette.
- **Balance:** about 60% ground, 25% accent and its warm neighbours, 15% cream and ink.
  To change the mood, change the ground and the accent as a pair (red on teal, ochre on navy, coral on sage).
- **One accent colour travelling through every shot** ties a short film together.

### 1.2 Materials (baked once, at build time)
| Element | How |
|---|---|
| hand-cut edge | subdivide each edge every ~10–16 px and push the points along the normal by noise (±1 px) |
| paper fibre | a tileable 512² texture of blotches and short fibres, laid over each sprite with `source-atop` at 0.2–0.45 |
| printed backdrop | a vertical gradient, two scales of soft-light mottling, faint print lines, dust, then a warm key-light glow falling to darker corners |
| print texture | parallel, slightly wobbly lines at 8–15% alpha inside a clip on fabric and façades; sparse specks on ceramics and fruit |
| contact shadow | the sprite's own silhouette, blurred, at 0.22–0.38 alpha, offset in world space and drawn first |
| rim of light | the silhouette minus itself shifted away from the light, composited `source-atop` |
| grain | a tile of light and dark specks, offset once per pose |

Bake each sprite at the largest zoom it will be seen at.

### 1.3 Staging
- **Frontal and orthographic.** Floors, ledges and pavements are horizontal bands, and things stand on them like objects on a shelf or a stage.
- **Depth by planes.** Use 3–7 flat sheets at depths p (sky 0.1–0.25 … the puppet plane 1). The camera move scales with p, so a push-in slides
  the sheets past each other.
- **Composition.** One thing moves the eye per shot. Negative space grows toward the end. One quiet oddity per film adds charm.

### 1.4 Characters and props
- **Puppets from flat parts on pivots:**
  - a coat or dress as one cut shape;
  - capsule or stick limbs;
  - a head sprite on a neck pivot, so it can tip and turn.
- **Faces:** drawn live over the head (dot eyes that blink into arcs, a blush that swells), like stop-motion replacement faces.
  Faceless figures work as well.
- **Flying things:** replacement drawings (three wing positions per wingbeat), not a rotated wing.
- **Props:** a body shape filled flat, then shading and texture inside a clip, then details. Everything gets fibre and a shadow.

### 1.5 The stop-motion clock
The picture runs on two clocks, and the contrast between them is the style:

| What | Rate |
|---|---|
| puppet poses | 12 or 15 a second: at 30 fps output, `qt = floor(t · 15) / 15`, so each pose holds for two frames |
| camera | every frame, eased (slow push-ins and drifts) |
| boil | per pose: ±1 px and ±0.003 rad from `hash(id, pose)`, so each pose looks hand-placed again |
| exposure flicker | per pose: ±2.5% brightness from a hash |
| grain | per pose |

- **Divide the output rate evenly:** 24 fps output takes 12 poses a second; 30 fps takes 15 or 10.
  At 30 fps, 12 poses a second alternates two- and three-frame holds and reads as a stutter.
- **Act in explicit states:** a crouch before a jump, a squash on landing, heads turning one after another.

### 1.6 Physics as the puppeteer
Ropes, falling petals, flocks and springy trees look alive when simulated. The film stays a pure function of time as a **deterministic replay**:
- each shot resets from seeded state and steps at a fixed 60 Hz up to the requested frame;
- pre-roll 1–2 s, so things are already moving when the shot starts;
- `draw` reads snapshots and never writes simulation state;
- long shots save a checkpoint every second.

| Thing | Model |
|---|---|
| steam, wires, hair | verlet ropes with gravity or buoyancy, curl-noise sway and pinned ends; perched weights pull a wire down |
| falling petals, feathers | flat-plate flutter: lift and drag with a self-excited pitch oscillation |
| a tree | a seeded branch skeleton with a torsion spring at each node, and forward kinematics |
| a flock | steer toward moving targets with separation, then home firmly to perches |
| hops and throws | ballistic arcs with a set flight time |

Tie events that must hit the music to exact frames. For a longer film, drop the replay: compute everything in closed form from t
(seeded emitters, paths as formulas), and keep the stop-motion clock for the poses.

### 1.7 Story shape and sound
- **A relay of cause and effect** suits a very short film: one handoff per shot, with the same object crossing each cut.
  For example, a note leaves one shot and wakes a bird in the next.
- **A character living the message** suits a talk or a reminder: one set, a few long movements, captions narrating his story.
- **Every note of a melody can also be a visual event:** a bloom, or the pluck of a wire.
- **Sound is synthesised from one score**, for both live playback and offline export (see [音乐与事件声音](../modules/music.md); only when the production phase authorizes audio):
  - a music box (a few inharmonic partials with fast decays and a click);
  - a Karplus–Strong wire; wing flaps (band-passed noise bursts);
  - chirps (a swept sine with light FM); paper rustle; a ceramic clink; creaks and whooshes;
  - per-shot room tones through a generated reverb.

### 1.8 Portrait and text
- **Portrait:** stack the staging vertically, with a sky band at the top, the ledge or street in the lower third and the hero centred.
  The camera tilts rather than tracks.
- **Text, when needed:** letters cut as paper sprites that arrive and boil like everything else, or a clean sans on a quiet band.

### 1.9 Pitfalls
- **`draw` must not touch simulation state.** Otherwise a frame reached after rendering differs from the same frame replayed cold, which `verify.mjs`
  catches. Key any draw cache by the state it depends on.
- **Start shots on the pose grid,** or pose changes and boil drift apart.
- **Pre-roll every shot,** or ropes start out straight.
- **Keep the shadow direction global:** offset it in world space before rotating or flipping.
- **Too many specks turn to noise at thumbnail size;** keep speckle alpha around 0.25–0.5.
- **Bake once and reuse sprites across shots;** blurred shadows are the costly part.

## 2. Paper lightbox diptych

A 20 s saying told in one scene in Canvas 2D.

**Look.** Layered cut paper at night, lit from behind: each sheet is one flat colour with hand-cut edges, paper fibre, a thin rim of light on the
edge that faces the light, and a soft shadow on the sheet behind. Lights (windows, lanterns, neon) are separate additive sheets. The sky is indigo,
warm (gold, amber, rose) behind one side and neon (magenta, cyan, violet) behind the other. A wet floor mirrors both.

**The diptych.** For a saying about two ways, split one scene down a vertical axis instead of cutting between two places: two faceless figures
back to back, each facing his own world, and one hero object behind both, split by the same axis. Here that object is a sun medallion
of 336 inlay pieces. One half gathers, locks and lights from within; the other hovers loose, goes cold, blows away and leaves a ghost lattice.
Every contrast is paired: warm and cold light, still and restless motion, hands at rest and hands grasping, coins that come and a coin that is
empty, flagstones and a wet street. Choose each side from the reading direction and the intended meaning; there is no universally favoured side.

**Recipes (all closed-form in `t`):**
- *Depth without 3D:* each sheet has a depth p (sky 0 … the figures 1, the foreground > 1). The screen scale is `S · zoom^p` and the centre
  `R + p · (cam − R)`, so zooms and pans slide the sheets past each other. Hide each sheet's base behind the one in front by running walls
  down past the ground line.
- *A medallion of pieces:* zig-zag rings, with vertices alternating r ± a, and bands of cells between them, with a half-cell offset every other
  band. Build each cell from the inner ring's points between its two angles plus the outer ring's points reversed, and clip any cell that
  straddles the axis in two (Sutherland–Hodgman against x = 0). Bake each piece three times (plain, backlit warm, neon cold) and crossfade.
  - A piece's state is closed-form: for the burst, pull it toward one of 5 spiral-arm angles and add a spin that grows with radius, so the arms
    unwind as it comes home. Lock it with an ease-out-back at a time staggered by radius and angle. Keep a loose piece loose with noise.
    Give fast pieces two fading copies at t − 0.025 and t − 0.05.
- *Scattering that stays in view:* don't blow the pieces off-screen. A client wanted scattered affairs "dispersed and visible … a mess in
  the sky on his side".
  - Give each piece a target on that side: two thirds in a few piles, a third strewn. Match targets to pieces by angle around the burst
    point, so the burst reads as outward.
  - Ease there with `(1 − e^(−4u)) / (1 − e^(−4))` for clamped u in [0,1], a burst that slows to a drift. End at a random angle and a new depth, and let some pieces keep turning.
  - Draw them in front of the far buildings. His props (bags, phone) join the mess.
  - When he reaches, push the nearest pieces away from his hands. That is "it does not come to him", with no text needed.
- *The wet floor:* after the figures, copy the canvas above the line of their feet into an offscreen flipped (`setTransform(1,0,0,-1,0,h)`)
  with `blur(2px)`. Lay it back in 6 px strips nudged sideways by `sin(y·0.05 + t)`, with alpha falling off as (1 − d)^1.5. Draw
  anything that lies on the floor (coins) afterwards.
- *Figures:* capsule limbs on a joint skeleton, drawn live into their own sheet each frame. Add paper fibre and the rim of whatever light the
  figure faces: the silhouette minus itself shifted away from the light, composited `source-atop`. Expose the world positions of the eye and
  palm (through the lean and head turn), so props land exactly.
- *Hook:* the medallion bursts into spiral arms around a white-gold sun with rays, while big blurred pieces fly past the lens in screen space
  during the first second.
- *16:9 text:* when the hero object fills the height, put the words at the bottom over the dark floor (a pool gradient from the bottom).
  X has no UI over the top; Reels does, so portrait keeps the words at the top.

**Pitfalls.** A radial gradient filled into a rectangle smaller than its radius leaves a hard edge (fill the whole circle's box). A sprite
already baked around its centroid must not be offset by the centroid again, or every piece collapses to the middle. The medallion's loose
half had to be displaced about 12% of its radius, with ±0.3 rad of rotation, before it read as "not gathered" at thumbnail size.

# 图片调度与密集展示

输入实际图片、来源许可、原始像素、焦点/保护区、用途和时间表；先看每张图再做裁切。不能仅凭文件名或提示词推断人脸/文字的位置。实现见 [data-ui](../implementations/data-ui/README.md)，几何复用 `motion-core.mjs`。

## 看图与裁切记录

每张写：id、file、width/height、焦点 `[x,y]`（归一化0–1）、必须保留的 bbox、文字区、可裁区域、许可与是否有修改。示例 bbox `[.15,.1,.55,.8]` 表示 x/y/宽/高，不是真实图像标注。脸、手持产品、图内标题都可能是保护对象。

cover 基础倍率 `s=max(目标宽/原宽,目标高/原高)`；额外 zoom≥1，最终倍率=s×zoom。超过1意味着原像素被放大，不凭算法宣称清晰。`coverCrop` 在边缘会钳位焦点，所以“锁焦点”在贴边图上不保证始终处于屏幕中心；先留足裁切余量或重排框。`visibleBoxFraction` 只能估算 bbox 可见比例，不理解脸是否被切坏。

## 深度配方

| 目的 | 前态→运动→停留→交接 | 参数起点 | 失败与修复 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ken Burns 引导细节 | 完整建立图→缓慢靠近真实焦点→停在证据→同焦点接下图 | 4–8 s，zoom 1→1.04–1.12，log zoom；`KenBurns` | 每张都无意义推近→按语义选择推/拉/静止；焦点被钳位→换图框/补余量 |
| 切层视差 | 前中后景 mask先明确→各深度按同相机移动→静止 | 位移8–40 px、depth .2/.5/1 | 人物边缘露洞→补背景或缩小动作；整图多次错位不是分层 |
| 拼贴/纸面 | 基底→主图落到接触面→副图补关系→主图保持 | 轻旋转±2–5°、落位0.3–0.6 s、影随高度变化 | 阴影固定而图悬浮→把距离、软度、透明度联动；读图不需持续晃动 |
| 网格重组 | 稳定id槽位→相邻交换/聚类→重点图扩展 | 0.5–1 s，所有图共享一组位置关键帧 | 图在中间变身份→不要按数组索引当key；先布局后运动 |
| 轮播/画廊隧道 | 当前图稳定→下一张在空间中接近→成为主焦点 | 侧图降低对比，运动0.6–1.2 s，展示窗另算 | 透视倾斜导致图中文字不可读→正面停靠；深层图不要求读 |
| 前后对比 | 同尺度同锚点显示一侧→明确分隔线擦出另一侧→停留 | 0.8–1.6 s，可标“前/后”；同crop参数 | 不同裁切/光线伪造改进→统一条件并标处理范围 |
| 图片+文字 | 图先建立主体，文字在稳定负空间出现→共同停留 | 正文区域留固定底色/遮让，安全区按画幅 | 背景虽暗仍高频→减少细节/重排，别只加阴影 |

## “三百多种选几十种”四段设计

1. **建立分类**：先用3–5个代表建立区别，写清选择维度，如印刷/几何/立体，而非随意颜色。类别名有读窗。
2. **密集快闪**：选出的图按色/形/构图分组，统一焦点、边界、槽位。每图0.08–0.25 s只能感知风格和节奏，不能要求读正文；依目标帧率保证每图至少实际有帧。起点不是保证可读的规范。
3. **重点停留**：从快闪中留2–4个代表，停2–4 s或按图内信息重算；可在同位置放大，建立“刚才看到的是这个”。
4. **收束**：回到分类关系或最终选择。音轨先按该密度结构设计，作者选音后用实测事件调整允许浮动的图切，保持重点读窗。

`PhotoMontage` 使用显式 `slots[]` 的 start/end 秒，半开区间；间隙显示背景，重叠会报错。需要叠化用 `TransitionOverlap`，不能靠两张图共享某个模糊 active 判断。文件需已存在于目标工程 public；图片原像素与 metadata 要真实。无图时交任务卡，不冒称生成了素材。

```tsx
// 秒数只是计划，图片路径和标注须在实际素材看过后填写。
<PhotoMontage t={t} width={1920} height={1080} slots={[
  {id:'A',file:'images/A.jpg',width:2400,height:1600,focus:[.5,.45],start:0,end:3.5,toZoom:1.06},
  {id:'B',file:'images/B.jpg',width:2400,height:1600,focus:[.6,.5],start:3.5,end:3.7},
]}/>
```

快闪/网格不能同时展示大量需要阅读的标题；文字说明应在建立和重点段承担。前后场景接缝看共同焦点、色块、运动方向，不为每张都加随机花哨转场。未来授权媒体检查应覆盖最窄裁切、最大zoom、切点、低分辨率素材和最终压缩；本版没有运行或渲染图片。

# 分支实现配方与专门检查

## 像素平台动作

逻辑画布320×180，输出1920×1080×1，倍率6；角色、tile、道具在逻辑坐标。步行动画12绘制fps，输出60fps时保持5帧；世界横移固定像素速度，脚落地帧锁住脚点。角色前缘碰到金币后才触发收集。调色板10–16色可作起点；Bayer图案在道具本地，缩放前计算。不使用弹簧、运动模糊、普通小数相机、粒子尾迹作为默认。

源码PixelStage负责低分辨率画布/最近邻，sprite负责字符图集，px负责取整，cycle负责色槽轮换，ridge提供固定噪声。中文另接真实字形。此配方尚未生成样片。

## 卡通反应

姿势表：注意（眼睛先）→转头→身体预备→行动→接触压扁→恢复/看结果。每姿势先看剪影；主手/脸不要被身体遮住。1–2px线条boil、两张/三张轮替可表现手绘，但阅读字幕层保持稳。Rough、Hatch、Sparkle、Smear属于辅助工艺，角色设计/演技仍需按内容制作。

## 印刷/拼贴

源图片保留可识别主体；网点映射亮度到点径，错版用于材质而不是错位事实。撕纸边沿轮廓含纤维，纸片受影与落地层级一致。字号叠描边时最宽层在底、填色最后，避免叠轮廓破坏字腔。不要让所有贴纸同时落下，按读序错开；没有理由时可以完全静止。

## 蓝图工程

L36原生机制：中心线→轮廓→细节→排线→尺寸→编号→说明；线宽随zoom^.65；对象与引线同坐标；纸纹在sheet坐标，字幕在独立屏幕overlay。尺寸/齿轮/链条要实际约束，不凭装饰数字。示例齿轮7.5°/八分音符只对应那个齿数；换齿数重新算啮合相位。

纸面合成可分ink灰度、fx影/湿/印章通道、subtitle最终层。实体先填纸再描轮廓，防后层穿透。云/多圆形体积用整体union渐变，逐圆着色会像葡萄；整体fill('nonzero')避免重复加法亮斑。来源示例是46.7秒接云机器，保留方法不照搬故事/署名。

## 3D标本/透明叠层

体素实例→多面体→软球→粒子场适合概念层级。关键事件共用t，先关闭不可见几何的高成本创建。透明叠层需背景透明/预乘一致；screen/additive在浅底会消失时切到正常混合并交叉淡入。空间标签按相机投影；切换before/after不能隐藏深度问题。

检查先看无后处理版本，以确认几何/光线/材质，再开Bloom/DOF。大场景3D缺包时列明，不能退成一张模糊图还称实现已完成。

# 转场：把上一镜的结果交给下一镜

先读 [镜头模块](../modules/camera.md)。转场的输入是一对已成立的镜头，不是效果名称。输出：交接对象、前后姿态、覆盖区间、切换事件、两场可见性与底色、声音关系。通用代码见 [transitions](../implementations/transitions/README.md)。下列秒数、像素数和幅度均为**示例起点**，不是验收门槛。

## 先为这两个镜头选择连接方式

| 两镜关系 | 优先尝试 | 决定前要写清 |
|---|---|---|
| 同一对象进入下一步、因果接续 | 对象接力、同位匹配、容器替换 | 对象身份是否相同；结果真的来自上一动作吗 |
| 同一空间看另一部分 | 推移、共享轴、跟随、拉远揭示 | 世界坐标和镜头方向是否一致 |
| 从总体进入细节 | 锚点放大、穿越、圆形揭示 | 入点在哪里；下一镜的尺度对应什么 |
| 回忆、时间经过、状态消融 | 叠化、柔边遮罩、噪声溶解 | 叠在一起会不会误读为同一时间 |
| 明确对比、笑点、跳跃 | 有动机硬切、定格后切 | 哪个变量保持，哪个变量突然改变 |
| 章节换画风 | 贯穿物承接、纸页/前景遮挡、材料变换 | 字体和角色身份如何保留；底色如何交接 |
| 没有可追踪共同点 | 简洁硬切或短叠化 | 不制造虚假的物理因果；不用炫技遮掩结构问题 |

选完以后，把上一镜最后的动作、下一镜最先可读的信息放在同一张时序表。转场期间仍在阅读的句子，不随整场剧烈缩放或模糊；可以留在屏幕层，待句子完成后再换。

## 共同的五段时序

1. **准备**：上一镜结论已经可读，交接对象开始获得注意。需要离场的次要层先退。
2. **接近**：对象/镜头向切换位置运动。方向、速度、锚点先确定，遮罩再跟随。
3. **交接**：用事件 `E_HANDOFF` 标记哪一帧由下一镜承担主要信息。这个事件不一定在转场正中。
4. **到达**：新镜头延续上一动作或明确打断它；两场叠层仍存在，直到旧场不可见。
5. **阅读**：新镜头的必要信息落稳后开始计算阅读窗，转场时长不能抵扣完整阅读窗。

覆盖时长为 D，序列 A 长 DA、B 长 DB：若 B 提前 D 开始，总长是 DA+DB−D。若已写了绝对 start/end，直接取最大 end，不能再减一次 D。Sequence 的入出帧由绝对边界各取整一次。连续三场同时重叠需要单独设计，本包基础 SceneStack 会拒绝它。

## 1. 同对象接力与匹配剪辑

**适用**：同一个角色、纸片、证据、光标或形状在新语境继续发挥作用。**换方案**：对象只有颜色相似，却没有语义关系；这时硬切反而更诚实。

操作：记录 A 的屏幕锚点、外接框、旋转、朝向、速度，再算 B 的对应状态。`matchAnchor(source,target,scale,rotation)` 返回平移，变换原点须为 `0 0`。先对齐位置，再调比例与方向，最后决定是否保留材质变化。切在运动中时匹配的是速度向量，不仅是位置。

| 参数 | 单位/示例起点 | 调整方向 |
|---|---|---|
| 锚点误差 | 1080p 下 0–8 px | 对比证据接近 0；快速动作可更宽松，靠实际观看判断 |
| 交接预备 | .15–.4 s | 看不出对象被选中就延长准备，不延长空转 |
| 容器收缩 | 1→.92，.15 s | 表示提交/收束；不让容器内文字被挤扁 |
| 接管 | 一帧，或 .08–.18 s 材质交叠 | 身份需要明确时先用一帧匹配，不默认双影 |

坏例：上一镜把圆形缩到角落，下一镜从中央重新长出另一个圆。修法：保留同一屏幕坐标；若是换对象，交代替换动作。检查 C 前后位置、比例、方向以及字幕是否无意被一起带走。

## 2. 遮挡与遮罩擦除

**适用**：门、纸页、人物、前景物体自然经过画面；或从已知焦点揭示新内容。实现有 `directionalWipe`、`iris`、`OccluderCut`。

- 方向擦除：A 留在底层，B 在上层遮罩从 0 到 100%。软边按画幅轴长的 .03–.12 起步；duration .3–.7 s。软边不是把文字本身模糊。
- 圆形揭示：圆心来自上一镜焦点；最终半径取到四角最远距离，不能仅用半个宽度。duration .35–.8 s；圆心不必在中心。
- 前景遮挡：遮挡物必须在切换帧真实覆盖需要切换的区域。基础组件的整屏挡板宽度至少 1W；窄人影只能做局部擦除，不能声称遮住了整屏硬切。
- 撕纸、墨迹、手绘擦除：用同一个局部坐标遮罩，先定纸缘/笔触形，再驱动面积；没有真实裂纹、墨迹扩散实现时不要用噪声淡入冒充。

坏例：遮罩包围全屏容器，但内容实际在世界 x=3200，边缘全被 border-box 裁掉。修法：让遮罩包住内容真实外接框，或者先把对象投影到屏幕空间。最大缩放时也须留足边距。

## 3. 画布扩展、收束与容器替换

**适用**：小对象成为章节舞台，输入框变成结果窗口，局部信息扩展为整体。先固定内容尺寸，动画外层 clip，不拉伸文字。

时序示例：.0–.18 s 框收窄；.18 s 换内容；.18–.55 s 新框展开；.45 s 新主体开始动作；框稳定后解释文字进入。共享轴 `sharedAxis('x'|'y'|'z')` 可以表示同一关系的前后层级。

参数：内容框宽高为 px；圆角为 px，随边界需要单独插值；轴移动 40–100 px；缩放 .88→1 是起点。避免每镜都把小圆撑成全屏，表达不同关系时改变连接逻辑，而不只是换颜色。

## 4. 路径、形变与轮廓交换

**适用**：一个形状确实能成为另一个，或路径自己承载因果。输入 A/B 的路径、轮廓数量、点序、绕向、孔洞和对应关系。拓扑不同先拆成共同部分与增减部分；不能直接把 SVG 的任意字符串逐字插值。

可执行办法：把闭合轮廓重采样到相同点数；比较旋转索引找较短对应路径；固定绕向；孔洞分别对应；用 `lerp(A[i],B[i],ease(p))`。这是**算法配方**，本包没有通用拓扑匹配器。复杂汉字不默认做轮廓 morph，优先用 [文字交接](kinetic-type-and-emphasis.md) 中的光学替换。

示例：64–256 个轮廓点，.5–1.2 s；更多点提高成本，不能修复错的对应。坏例是中间自交、字腔翻面；先修映射而非增加缓动。

## 5. 翻页、翻面与折叠

`pageFlip` 是单平面的 CSS 3D 翻面，**不模拟纸张弯曲**。背面设置 backfaceVisibility:hidden；A/B 在同一透视空间，旋转方向一致。90° 时两面都接近消失，根底色必须使用合适的承接颜色。

参数：perspective 900–1800 px；.45–.9 s；铰链可设左边/中央，内容主体别压在铰链上。真实折页用分条网格，每条独立角度与遮挡排序；若需要自阴影/曲面反射，转真实 3D，列明可选依赖。

坏例：正面读到一半被转走；反面文字镜像；两面同时正对镜头形成双影。修法：完整阅读后启动，背面使用反向初始角度，不在同一个 div 同时装正反内容。

## 6. 粒子与碎片重组

**适用**：分散→汇聚、复杂→秩序、材料转换。用 [群体配方](formation-and-mosaic.md) 与 [粒子背景实现](../implementations/backgrounds/README.md)。目标字形/图像先在资源就绪后采样，固定粒子 ID 和 A→B 目标分配。

时序：轻收拢 .12–.25 s → 爆开 .2–.45 s → 趁飞行中转向 .4–1.2 s → 全体到位后静读。数字和密度仅为起点；最迟粒子的 delay+settle 决定整体落稳。准备、爆开、聚合不必每次全用。

坏例：聚字期间背景粒子同样亮，字腔消失；随机重新分配使 seek 变化。修法：降低阅读区尘点、固定 seed+id、重用映射，先去掉辉光再调密度。仅把矩形碎成小方块不等于理解了新的含义。

## 7. 空间穿越与缩放穿透

**适用**：进入对象内部、局部到整体、从概念到证据。设 portal 中心与入口比例 k，下一镜初始范围必须对应这个入口。`zoomThrough` 提供光学缩放接力；真实嵌套空间需要 [相机锚点](camera-moves.md) 与对象层级。

尺度用 log 插值；factor 2–4、.4–.8 s 起步。多层穿越时记录每层相对变换，避免第三层凭感觉摆放。非常小的 k 会把贴图放大到模糊，须提前计算素材分辨率。

坏例：A 推近，B 却向相反方向飞进；字幕也被放大几十倍。修法：方向一贯、屏幕字幕独立、切换在共同锚点，文字阅读结束后再进入强缩放。

## 8. 光、闪白与色彩接力

**适用**：曝光变化、灯光开启、强能量释放或明确风格化剪辑。`fadeThrough` 的中间态就是根底色；想过白明确设白，想过暗明确设暗，不能依赖浏览器默认白页。

明暗共享 `dark(t)` 驱动背景、灯光、材质、雾和后期，承载物保留。时长 .4–1.2 s；漏光强度、颜色和方向与环境一致。闪白不是每拍装饰；连续重复闪烁会伤害观看，优先用局部亮度和轮廓能量。

声音可用上升气流提前引导，再在动作/接管事件释放；不要每次机械叠同一 whoosh。中途有意静音可以成立，不复制“声音永远不能静音”的来源规则。

## 9. 机械、格栅、网格与像素化

`gridMask(cols,rows,seed,order)` 用一个 SVG 遮罩揭示整场，不克隆几十份视频。顺序可为列、对角或固定随机；条带用 rows=1 或 cols=1。起点 12×7 网格、.35–.75 s；信息密集时减格数。

像素分支按逻辑格推进，nearest 与整数位置一并成立；网格揭示本身**不是图像像素化滤镜**。真实 pixelate 要降低离屏分辨率后 nearest 放大，再恢复尺寸。格栅的总 stagger 不能超过重叠区间；最后一格结束才可卸旧场。

## 10. 节奏硬切、定格与甩镜

硬切不需要两场重叠；可切在动作峰值、静止后的反差或观点转折。定格用明确 hold 状态，不靠截断播放偶然得到。甩镜 `whipPan` 使用同向高速位移与短时 blur；CSS blur 是各向同性近似，不是真实方向性运动模糊。

示例：甩镜 .16–.35 s、blur 8–20 px；像素/印刷风可关模糊用 1–2 张 smear 姿态。多次子帧采样需对位置和相机在每个采样时刻重算，成本近似按采样数增长。不要对有文字阅读任务的整屏长期甩动。

## 最后要留下的记录

每个接缝留：A/B、语义关系、承载物、start/end、E_HANDOFF、前后锚点/速度、底色、音效事件与感知峰值偏移、阅读窗是否完整。媒体阶段再检查交接前后、运动峰值与结果稳态；本次只交源码与配方，未播放或渲染。

# 字体与线描的可执行配方

## 语义块揭示

明确parts数组、每块起点a、揭示时长d、最后块落稳fLast、readHold。单块mask内部translateY从100%到0；外层负责定位，内层负责动画。`fLast=max(a_i+d_i)`，场景末帧≥fLast+readHold。中文不按空格分词；两关键词可以动，解释句可以整句静止。

## 真实字形解剖

glyph_outline.py读取本地字体、单字符cmap，用fontTools实例化wght并取得SVG路径、控制点和轮廓。GlyphAnatomy显示路径、节点、手柄和字形测量。输入字体不含字符时明确失败；wght只在存在时有效。字体单位upm与画面尺寸换算，y轴翻转要一致；所有clip ID独立。

此法展示轮廓构造，不提供汉字笔顺。把轮廓按总长度描出可能先走内孔、再外轮廓，不能称“书写汉字”。需要笔顺时给真正笔画数据或经核验的骨架路径。

## 原画沿线显现

原图保持不变；骨架遮罩只控制可见性。流程：透明/亮度阈值→骨架→分叉处分段→指定起点和分组→按连接/距离排序→沿弧长推进笔刷。局部宽度取距离变换半径×2加余量。小闭合眼睛不能作为毛刺全部剪掉；只剪挂在真实分叉（度≥3）的短末端。实心头发等按长度×(1+宽/60)增加时间，避免两帧黑团突然冒出。

Renoise pen_order/vectorize_lineart是原位研究入口；vectorize以4倍上采样、轻模糊、.5阈值、.25px简化保留孔洞，适合黑线稿，不适合多色照片。当前包未附未经完整审阅的pen_order实现；不能把路径配方当已验证工具。选用前读完整原实现并核依赖。

## 复用工艺源码

保留VarType（可变轴+逐字）、OutlineFill（轮廓到填色）、HandReveal（横向遮罩）、TrackIn（字距收拢）、Decode（确定性乱码）及字体载入器。HandReveal是横向显现，不是真正笔尖走字；空字符串允许无内容，cps≤0拒绝。TrackIn默认含blur，可按安静/像素需求使用别的组件，不强行叠上。

lineart保留Stroke、Oneline、penAt、chainPen、SketchDefs、Paper。每段时间窗必须非零；空链明确报错。多处Paper/SketchDefs需不同ID或每画面只挂一次；SVG滤镜用户空间区域按实际世界范围设置。

## 返修检查点

字形就绪后第一帧、半揭示、最后落字、最长行、最窄画幅、最强scale、进出场重叠。检查“描边太粗”先按屏幕尺度调整，不必把原路径整体缩小；检查“像打印机”先把横向揭示误称书写的问题改清楚。

> 完整的16种状态变换配方。先读 ../modules/product.md 与 ../modules/motion.md。示例词、数值、幽灵轮廓、HUD、弹簧、背景漂移都可替换或省略；保留因果和共享对象。中文按语义词组；图表只在数据含有连续/有序关系时连线。示例数值不得冒充事实。只有选择loop时要求端点一致；导出帧通常是[0,T)，不额外重复T帧。

# The 16 effects, as build recipes



These examples use an 8-second demonstration loop; map the phases to your authored timeline, or use hold mode under narration. Times are seconds from the start of the loop.



| Phase | Seconds | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| Start | 0.0 | The start state, held for one frame |
| Move | 0.0 to 2.2 | The one change, eased in and out (cubic) |
| Hold | 2.2 to 6.6 | The finished state. A complete readable state; small secondary motion is optional |
| Return | 6.6 to 8.0 | Everything eases back to the start state |
| Loop | 8.0 | Identical to 0.0, pixel for pixel |



Inside the move, parts start at different moments. "Early" means the first 0.8 seconds, "middle" about 0.8 to 1.4, "late" 1.4 to 2.2.



Colour roles below are written as **ground**, **surface**, **ink**, **muted**, **accent** and **second accent**. Take every one from your project design tokens. The demo words in each recipe show the shape of the content. Replace them with the user's real words.

## Interfaces: show a product doing something



### 01 Button → player



**What it is:** a small Preview button grows into a full video player.



- **Start:** a pill button with a play triangle and the word "Preview", top left, on a dark ground.

- **End:** a large player filling the tile: a thumbnail image, a title ("Spring launch"), a time readout ("0:17 / 0:42") and a progress bar with a round handle.

- **Timing:** 0.0 to 2.2 the button's own shell stretches into the player shape. Its label fades out in the first quarter of the move. The player contents fade in over the second half. The play icon travels from the button to the centre of the player, grows a dark disc behind it and turns from ink to surface colour. At about 2.6 the play icon morphs into pause. Through the hold the progress bar creeps forward and the time readout counts up. From 6.6 the pause turns back into play and the shell shrinks home.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** it is one object changing shape, never a fade from one thing to another. A faint ghost of the button stays where it started, so the eye sees where the player came from. The play-to-pause change is a morph of two shapes, not a swap.

- **Use it when:** you add a "watch the demo" moment to a landing page or launch email.



### 02 Search → results



**What it is:** a search box opens, a query types itself and results stack in.



- **Start:** a short pill with a magnifier and the grey placeholder "Search".

- **End:** a full-width search bar reading "spring campaign" and three result cards below it, each with a coloured tile, a title and one metric line ("Email · 48% opens").

- **Timing:** early, the pill widens to full width and a caret appears. From about 0.75 to 1.2 the query types one letter at a time. From 1.1 the three results rise 14 pixels into place, one after another, each starting a beat after the last. The hold keeps the finished list. The return reverses it, results first.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the pill opens before the typing starts, so the two moves never fight. Results stage in, they do not pop in together. Every result carries one real number, not filler bars.

- **Use it when:** you show what people find when they search your help centre or content library.



### 03 Card → workspace



**What it is:** one small card opens into the full editor it belongs to.



- **Start:** a collapsed card bottom left, outlined, titled "Q3 brief" with two grey text bars.

- **End:** an editor window: title bar with three dots, a sidebar with one active item in the accent colour, a document title ("Launch plan"), text bars, an image and two status chips ("Draft", "3 edits").

- **Timing:** 0.0 to about 1.4 the card's shell grows from its own corner into the window. Faint dashed guides run from the card's corners to the window's corners. The card's own text bars fade out in the first fifth. The window's contents only fade in once the shell is past halfway. The "Q3 brief" title travels from the card into the window's title bar. The hold keeps the open workspace. The return folds it back into the card.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the title is a shared element. It moves, it is never duplicated. A dashed ghost of the closed card stays at the origin. The contents wait until there is room for them, so nothing is squashed.

- **Use it when:** you announce a feature, and one small card becomes the whole editor.



### 04 Tabs → panels



**What it is:** a selected tab slides across to the next tab and the panel below changes with it.



- **Start:** three tabs (Reels, Posts, Email) with Reels selected in a dark pill. The panel shows "Reels this week", a count chip and three ranked rows.

- **End:** Posts selected. The panel shows "Posts this week", a new count and three new rows.

- **Timing:** early, the selection pill stretches. Its leading edge moves first and its trailing edge follows a beat behind, so the pill gets long, then short again as it lands. Two short speed lines trail it. Each tab label brightens as the pill covers it. From about 0.9 the panel header and the three rows swap, each sliding 14 to 16 pixels sideways as it fades, top row first.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the stretch. A pill that slides at one width looks mechanical. Label colour follows how much of the pill sits over it, so the text never flips.

- **Use it when:** you compare plans, packages or channels without a wall of text.



---



## Data and lists: make a point land



### 05 Chart morph



**What it is:** six bars turn into a line through their own tops.



- **Start:** a bar chart titled "Weekly reach", six bars (Monday to Saturday), light gridlines and a baseline. The label "illustrative" sits top right when the numbers are samples.

- **End:** a smooth line through the same six values, a soft fill under it, a dot on every point, the last point in the accent colour and a small tag showing its value ("92").

- **Timing:** from the start of the move each bar slims to a hairline, left to right, each a beat after the last. From about 0.84 the line draws on from left to right with the fill fading in under it. Each dot pops in as the line reaches it. At about 1.5 the value tag rises onto the last point. The return fattens the bars again and the line retracts.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the values never change. The same six numbers are bars and then a line, so the viewer trusts it. The line is drawn, it does not fade in.

- **Use it when:** you drop a weekly result into a client report or a results post.



### 06 Dashboard zoom



**What it is:** one KPI tile lifts out of a full dashboard and fills the frame.



- **Start:** a quiet dashboard: three KPI tiles, a trend line and two grey text bars.

- **End:** the dashboard dimmed behind a large card: "Signups", a delta chip ("+18%"), the big number ("12,480") and a sparkline.

- **Timing:** in the first 0.9 seconds four corner brackets in the accent colour snap around the chosen tile. Across the move the rest of the dashboard dims. From about 0.7 the tile scales forward from its exact position to the large card, with dashed guides joining the tile's corners to the card's. The card's contents fade in over the second half. The hold keeps the card. The return shrinks it back into its slot.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the card grows from the tile's real position and size, so it reads as the same object coming closer. The brackets say "this one" before anything moves.

- **Use it when:** you pull the one KPI that matters out of your monthly dashboard.



### 07 Spring stack



**What it is:** a neat stack of cards fans out and the top card overshoots, then settles.



- **Start:** three product cards stacked at the same angle. The top one shows an image, a name ("Summer kit"), a price and a tick button.

- **End:** the three cards fanned at three different angles.

- **Timing:** each card follows a real spring with its own damping. The back card is heavily damped, the middle one less, the top card least, so it swings past its resting angle and wobbles back. The top card leads, the others follow 0.05 and 0.1 behind. The spring has settled by about 1.8. A dashed ghost shows the top card's resting angle. While it swings, a short trail of accent dots follows its corner. A small easing graph in the corner shows a dot riding the overshoot curve in time with the card. The return eases all three back into the stack with no spring.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** springs, not easing curves, and different damping per card. The ghost and the curve inset explain the physics without a word.

- **Use it when:** you show three offers, case studies or testimonials, one after another.



### 08 Magnetic dock



**What it is:** a dark app dock whose icons swell as a cursor passes over them.



- **Start:** seven small square icons in a translucent dock, all the same size, cursor off to the right.

- **End:** the cursor over the middle of the dock, the icons nearest it grown, a label above the biggest one.

- **Timing:** during the move the cursor glides in and the icons grow. Each icon's size follows a bell curve of its distance from the cursor. The dock re-centres as it widens, so it grows around the cursor rather than to one side. Through the hold the cursor sweeps left and right once, and the swell and the label follow it. On the return the cursor leaves and the icons shrink.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the size is a smooth falloff, not "this icon big, the rest small". The label always sits over the largest icon, and a faint dashed curve above the dock draws the falloff.

- **Use it when:** you show the tools you use, or the integrations your product has.



---



## Type: make the words move



### 09 Masked type



**What it is:** artwork rises through the letters of a big outlined word.



- **Start:** the word "OPUS" as a thin outline, an issue label ("ISSUE 05") top left, a season top right, an empty line below.

- **End:** the letters filled with artwork, and a second line ("in motion") sitting under the word.

- **Timing:** over the first 1.35 seconds the fill edge rises from the bottom of the letters to the top. An accent line with a small square handle marks the edge as it climbs. From about 0.95 the second line rises into view from behind a clean cut line. The edge marker fades once the fill is complete.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the artwork only shows inside the letterforms. The second line is revealed by a mask, not faded in. The marker line shows the viewer what the motion is doing.

- **Use it when:** you reveal a campaign name, newsletter issue or launch headline.



### 10 Elastic type



**What it is:** each letter of a word stretches on one locked baseline.



- **Start:** the word "STRETCH" at rest on a labelled baseline, a small ghost of the word underneath.

- **End:** the letters stretched into a peak. The middle letter is the tallest and narrowest, and the rest fall away evenly on both sides.

- **Timing:** the stretch starts from the middle letter and spreads outwards, each pair a beat later. The middle letter peaks at about 1.3 and the outer letters finish with the move at 2.2. A cursor and a handle sit on the middle letter's top, with a dashed line showing how far it moved. A readout counts the width down ("wdth 100" to "wdth 62"). The hold keeps the peak. The return relaxes every letter together.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the baseline never moves. Letters change width as well as height, so the word stays one word. The middle letter is the only one in the accent colour.

- **Use it when:** you open an event, webinar or podcast with a moving title card.



### 11 Text → layout



**What it is:** one plain headline reflows into a full article page.



- **Start:** one line of small text in a dashed strip: "Design that moves people".

- **End:** an editorial page: a kicker ("FIELD NOTES"), the headline over two big lines, four body lines, an image and a pull quote card.

- **Timing:** from the start the headline splits into two halves that travel separately to their places and grow as they go. The second half drops down first and then slides left, so the halves never share a line. From about 0.8 dashed guides show where each half went and the source strip shows a ghost of the old line. The kicker fades in at about 1.0, the image wipes open left to right from about 1.05, the body lines draw on from about 1.1, and the quote card rises in last from about 1.2. The return collapses it back into one line.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the headline is the same text moving, never retyped. Everything else arrives in reading order.

- **Use it when:** you turn a blog headline into a carousel cover or article teaser.



### 12 Image reveal



**What it is:** dark shutter slats pull back to reveal an image.



- **Start:** the frame covered by seven dark vertical slats.

- **End:** the image in full, with a small label pill ("New drop") top left.

- **Timing:** each slat narrows to nothing towards its own centre line, left to right, each starting a beat after the last. The last slat is gone at about 1.7. The label fades in from about 1.05. The return closes the slats again.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** each slat has a faint light edge that shows it is a physical object, and the slats go in sequence rather than together.

- **Use it when:** you tease a product drop (and swap in your own photo afterwards).



---



## Systems: explain how things connect



### 13 Perspective shift



**What it is:** the flat layers of a page pull apart in depth.



- **Start:** three layers stacked almost flat, like one page: a chart layer at the back, a list layer in the middle, a page layout on top.

- **End:** the three layers spread apart and angled towards one vanishing point on the right, each still showing its own content.

- **Timing:** the layers separate back to front, each a beat behind the last. From about 0.9 dashed perspective guides fade in towards the vanishing point and a small dot marks it. Through the hold the vanishing point drifts gently up and down, so the whole stack breathes. The return flattens it again.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** every layer shares one vanishing point, so the depth is correct. Each layer keeps real content, which is what makes it read as "the layers of this thing" rather than three grey cards.

- **Use it when:** you explain the layers of your service, brand system or tech stack.



### 14 Glass focus



**What it is:** a lens slides down a blurred report and sharpens the row under it.



- **Start:** a report card ("Campaign report") with five rows of label and value, all softly blurred, and the lens on the first row.

- **End:** the lens resting on one row, that row sharp and slightly magnified.

- **Timing:** over the move the lens steps to the second row. Through the hold it travels down to the last row and back up to the second, following an eased curve. On the return it goes back to the first row.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** only the text inside the lens is sharp, at 1.1 times the size. Two faint tinted copies of that text sit a fraction of a pixel either side, like real glass. The lens has a highlight across its top and a double rim.

- **Use it when:** you make people read the one line of a report or pricing table you care about.



### 15 Flowing paths



**What it is:** pulses of light travel from one source, through three channels, into one result.



- **Start:** five labelled pills on a dark ground: "Brief" on the left, "Email", "Reel" and "Post" in the middle, "Report" on the right, joined by faint curved lines.

- **End:** every line lit, every node glowing.

- **Timing:** from 0.25 three pulses leave "Brief", 0.14 apart, and light the three connectors as they travel. Each takes about a second. When a pulse arrives, that node answers with an expanding ring and a brighter dot. From about 1.75 a second set of pulses runs from the three channels into "Report", and those lines shade from the cool colour to the accent colour. At about 3.6 a second wave repeats the journey along the lit paths. On the return the lights fade out.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the nodes respond on arrival, so cause and effect are visible. The line is drawn by the pulse, it does not switch on. The second wave keeps the hold alive.

- **Use it when:** you show one piece of content feeding several channels, or a simple funnel.



### 16 Particle logo



**What it is:** scattered dots fly in and form a logo.



- **Start:** a scatter of small dots on the left and a faint dashed outline of the mark on the right.

- **End:** the dots packed into the mark, a ring with a diamond inside, the diamond in the accent colour. A label ("Mark 01") top left and "assembled" bottom right.

- **Timing:** each dot starts its flight at a slightly different moment, leftmost dots first with a little randomness, spread over the first 1.1 seconds. Each flies on a gentle arc with a short trail behind it. The last dots land at the end of the move, and at about 2.0 the label changes from "assembling" to "assembled". The return scatters them back to their exact starting points.

- **Mechanism to preserve:** the dots sit on a grid inside the mark's real shape, so the finished logo is crisp. The scatter is seeded, so every loop is identical. The trails show direction without blur.

- **Use it when:** you close a video, reel or launch post with your mark.

# Choreography



## Coordinated Entry Rules



### 1. Lead with the Hero

- Hero gets largest displacement and most attention-grabbing easing

- Supporting elements are subtler in every dimension



### 2. Spatial Origin Consistency

All elements enter from same direction or shared origin. Mixed directions = chaos.



### 3. Counter-Motion



| Hero Motion | Counter-Motion | Speed Ratio |
|-------------|---------------|-------------|
| Enters left | Background shifts right | 20-30% |
| Scales up | Shadow scales down | 10-20% |
| Rotates CW | Ambient drifts CCW | 15-25% |
| Lifts (Y up) | Shadow spreads + softens | 20-30% |



## Sequence Structure



| Phase | Duration Share | What Happens |
|-------|--------------|-------------|
| Setup | 20-30% | Elements enter, scene establishes |
| Action | 30-40% | Primary motion, hero moment |
| Resolution | 30-40% | Settle, secondary reactions, breathing |



Leave 100-200ms stillness after resolution before new motion.



## The 1/3 Rules



**Distance**: No motion travels >1/3 screen without intermediate keyframe. Break with direction changes, speed variations, or arc adjustments.



**Elements**: With 3+ animated elements, max 1/3 active simultaneously. Stagger so element 1 settles as element 3 starts.



## Stagger Patterns



| Pattern | Description | Best For |
|---------|------------|----------|
| Sequential | Reading order | Lists, grids |
| Center-out | Radiating from center | Hero content, ripples |
| Random | Varied timing | Organic, particle-like |
| Wave | Sine-based | Data bars, continuous |
| Reverse | Bottom-to-top | Exits, backward nav |



- All staggered elements use same easing family

- Vary only start time, not curve

- Optional: last element gets slight overshoot (punctuation)



## Shared Motion Events



When multiple elements react to one trigger:

- All start within 50ms of each other

- Can arrive at different times (staggered landing)

- Same easing family; motion originates from trigger point



## Attention Direction



| Technique | Implementation |
|-----------|---------------|
| Leading motion | Animate target before context |
| Following motion | Settle on focal point |
| Ambient motion | Subtle continuous in periphery |
| Pointing motion | Directional toward CTA |



### Depth Through Speed



| Layer | Displacement | Speed |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| Foreground | 1.0x | Fastest |
| Midground | 0.5x | Medium |
| Background | 0.2x | Slowest |



## Common Recipes



### Dashboard Load

1. Skeletons fade in (100ms)

2. Hero metric (250ms, ease-out, 100ms delay)

3. Supporting cards stagger (50ms between, 200ms each)

4. Chart data draws in (300ms, starts with cards)

5. Ambient pulse on primary metric



### Modal Open

1. Background dims (200ms)

2. Modal scales 95%→100% + fades (300ms, 50ms delay)

3. Content fades in (200ms, 100ms after modal)

4. Close button last (150ms)



### List Update (item added)

1. Existing items shift down (200ms, ease-in-out)

2. New item fades+slides from top (250ms, ease-out, 50ms delay)

3. Subtle scale overshoot on land (3-5%)

# Context Adaptation



## Platform Scaling



| Platform | Duration Modifier | Complexity | Physics |
|----------|------------------|------------|---------|
| Desktop | 1.0x (baseline) | Full | All types |
| Tablet | 0.9x | Standard | Most types |
| Mobile | 0.8x | Reduced (1-2 properties) | Snappy only |
| Watch | 0.6x | Minimal (1 property) | None |
| TV/Kiosk | 1.3x | Full | All types |



**Mobile rules**: prefer opacity + transform; touch feedback <100ms; reduce stagger budgets by 30%; avoid parallax

**Desktop opportunities**: hover states, cursor tracking, multi-column stagger, spatial choreography



## Accessibility



### prefers-reduced-motion



| Original Motion | Reduced Alternative |
|----------------|-------------------|
| Slide entrance | Opacity fade only |
| Bounce/spring | Instant or simple ease-out |
| Parallax | Static positioning |
| Auto-playing | Paused, user-initiated |
| Complex choreography | Single fade |
| Continuous ambient | Static or subtle opacity pulse |



Reduced motion means: remove spatial movement, keep opacity, remove spring easing, reduce duration 50%+, never auto-play loops.



### Vestibular Triggers (avoid or provide alternatives)

- Large-scale zoom, full-screen position transitions

- Spinning elements >100px, parallax >2 layers, rapid direction changes



### Cognitive Accessibility

- Same interaction = same animation every time

- Pause controls for animations >5 seconds

- Don't convey critical info through motion alone



## Performance Budgets



| Tier | Properties | Max Elements |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| Optimal | transform, opacity | Unlimited (GPU) |
| Good | + color, clip-path | 10-15 |
| Acceptable | + width, height, margin | 5-8 |
| Avoid | box-shadow, border-radius, filter | 1-3 |



- Target 60fps (16.67ms/frame); animation logic <10ms/frame

- will-change sparingly; keep animated elements <20 per viewport

- Stagger reduces peak load vs simultaneous

- Fallback: 30fps acceptable for ambient



## Content Type Adaptation



| Content Type | Personality | Duration | Motion Density |
|-------------|-------------|----------|---------------|
| Financial | Corporate/Premium | 250-500ms | Low |
| Social media | Playful | 150-300ms | Medium |
| Enterprise SaaS | Corporate | 200-400ms | Low |
| Gaming | Energetic | 100-250ms | High |
| Healthcare | Corporate/Calm | 300-600ms | Very low |
| E-commerce | Varies | 200-400ms | Medium |
| Editorial | Premium | 350-600ms | Low |
| Children's apps | Playful | 150-300ms | High |



## Responsive Motion



| Container Width | Max Displacement | Duration |
|----------------|-----------------|----------|
| <400px | 20% of width | 0.8x |
| 400-800px | 25% of width | 1.0x |
| 800-1200px | 20% of width | 1.0x |
| >1200px | 15% of width | 1.1x |



- Small viewport: sequential, one element at a time

- Medium: standard stagger, 2-3 columns

- Large: full choreography, center-out stagger, parallax



## Dark Mode

- Reduce motion intensity 10-20% (bright on dark = more impact)

- Subtler ambient motion; careful with opacity values

- Avoid pure white flashes

# Core Philosophy



## Three Pillars



### Pillar 1: Emotional Intent

Define target emotion before choosing any property.



| Emotion | Character | Timing | Easing |
|---------|----------|--------|--------|
| Trust | Smooth, predictable | 300-400ms | Gentle curves |
| Delight | Bouncy, surprising | 200-300ms | Overshoot |
| Urgency | Sharp, direct | 100-200ms | Snappy ease-out |
| Calm | Slow, flowing | 500-1000ms | Sine curves |
| Surprise | Sudden, explosive | 150-300ms | Exponential |
| Confidence | Direct, decisive | 200-400ms | Strong ease-out |



### Pillar 2: Visual Narrative



| Phase | Duration Share | Purpose |
|-------|--------------|---------|
| Setup | 20-30% | Establish context, prepare viewer |
| Action | 30-40% | Primary motion, hero moment |
| Resolution | 30-40% | Settle, breathe, confirm |



Even a 200ms tooltip fade has implicit setup→action→resolution.



### Pillar 3: Motion Craft

- Easing curves match emotional intent

- Duration proportional to element size and distance

- Arcs for organic, straight for mechanical

- Secondary motion (shadows, related elements)

- Nothing starts and stops all at once



## Three Motion Layers



| Layer | Role | Amplitude |
|-------|------|-----------|
| Primary | Main action viewer follows | 100% |
| Secondary | Supporting richness | 30-50% |
| Ambient | Background life | 10-20% |



- Secondary offset 50-100ms from primary, different easing

- Ambient is continuous/slow, never demands attention

- Primary-only animation feels flat; always add secondary + ambient



## The 1/3 Screen Rule

No motion travels >1/3 screen without intermediate keyframe. Break with direction changes, speed shifts, or arc adjustments.



## The Attention Budget

- One hero motion per scene moment

- Max 2-3 elements in active motion simultaneously

- Ambient doesn't count against budget

- Stagger rather than synchronize

# Decision Framework



## The First Questions



### 1. Purpose?



| Purpose | Approach | Priority |
|---------|----------|----------|
| Draw attention | Scale, color, pulse | Responsiveness |
| Guide sequence | Stagger, directional flow | Clarity |
| Provide feedback | Immediate response | Speed |
| Create atmosphere | Subtle, continuous | Subtlety |
| Explain relationship | Position, connection | Legibility |
| Celebrate/reward | Overshoot, particles | Delight |



### 2. Audience?

- Stressed → calm motion; Browsing → richer motion

- Task-focused → fast, minimal; Exploring → can be dramatic

- Seen 100x/day → fast, subtle; Seen once → can be dramatic



### 3. Context?

- Busy layout → simpler motion; Empty → can be dramatic

- Other animations active → coordinate or stagger

- Small container → small motion



## 4-Level Decision Hierarchy



### Level 1: Motion Category



| Category | When |
|----------|------|
| Revealing | Content appearing |
| Concealing | Content disappearing |
| Transitioning | Between states/views |
| Emphasizing | Drawing attention |
| Responding | Reacting to interaction |
| Ambient | Background atmosphere |



### Level 2: Motion Personality

Match to brand. See [motion-personality.md](motion-personality.md).



### Level 3: Motion Direction



| Direction | Communicates |
|-----------|-------------|
| Upward | Growth, aspiration |
| Downward | Settling, completion |
| Leftward | Regression, departure |
| Rightward | Progression, arrival |
| Outward (scale up) | Importance, emergence |
| Inward (scale down) | Dismissal, removal |
| Center-seeking | Focus, convergence |
| Center-fleeing | Distribution, release |



### Level 4: Implementation Properties

Choose animated properties. See [property-selection.md](../reference/property-selection.md).



## Decision Quick-Path



```

1. PURPOSE → What does this motion DO?

   ├── Feedback → short, ease-out, minimal

   ├── Entrance → ease-out, personality-matched

   ├── Exit → ease-in, 70% of entrance

   ├── Emphasis → scale or color pulse

   └── Ambient → slow, continuous, sine



2. PERSONALITY → Match keywords

   ├── Fun/bouncy → Playful

   ├── Elegant/luxury → Premium

   ├── Clean/professional → Corporate

   └── Bold/dynamic → Energetic



3. PROPERTIES → Minimum needed (two = sweet spot)



4. TIMING → Check duration table, adjust for distance/weight



5. EASING → Entering=ease-out, Leaving=ease-in, On-screen=ease-in-out, Looping=sine

```

| Purpose | Clear function? |
| Personality | Matches brand/context? |
| Repetition | Fine on 100th viewing? |
| Attention | Respects viewer's focus? |
| Hierarchy | Reinforces importance? |
